body:
Why do opponents of voting rights keep trying to make it harder to vote? Why are they trying day after day to limit pathways for you to submit your ballot?
It's simple -- they know that their voters and supporters have no trouble taking time off or being late to work to go vote. They know that their voters have plenty of polling locations with short lines and barely any waiting. They know they can chip at the margins here and there and win elections by limiting drop boxes, closing polling locations in certain communities, and reducing early voting hours and availability.
RUSH $25 or more right now to fight back and make voting accessible for everyone, from Ohio to every other state in our country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=091524_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=091524_3&amount=25]
Ohio Capital Journal: Ohio Sec. of State LaRose proposes eliminating ballot drop boxes, changes rules ahead of election [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=091524_3&amount=25]
Drop boxes are threatened in Ohio by the very elected official whose job is to run the election, Team.
Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose has asked leaders in the Ohio state legislature to create a law eliminating ballot drop boxes even after a court ruled that people with disabilities should have more opportunities to vote.
LaRose also used his own powers as Secretary of State to add more steps before voters can use drop boxes ahead of the November election. His actions will disenfranchise millions of voters this fall : 1 in 4 Ohioans voted absentee in their last election, according to state data.
This hurts Ohio's voters, from working families to college students to the elderly. **Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

That’s the number of votes that decided the result in Arizona’s presidential election in 2020. **That’s just .3% of all votes cast.** And in 2024, Kamala Harris and Donald Trump are polling in a dead-heat. Just as close.

| | Republican vice presidential nominee JD Vance has made quite a few headlines recently. Whether he's disparaging "childless cat ladies" or opining on the "purpose of a postmenopausal woman," all his statements seem focused on promoting his narrow, oppressive worldview in the name of being "pro-family." Aside from the obvious reality that the Democratic agenda – chock full of initiatives like paid family and sick leave, tackling the housing crisis, and defending IVF – is the most pro-family agenda around, it's Vance's hypocrisy that never fails to surprise. He talks a big game about the importance of family and how government should be doing more to encourage people to start families, but **when it comes down to taking action to support families? He's nowhere to be found.** What gives? Earlier this year, my proposal to expand the Child Tax Credit, a proven success in helping lift kids out of poverty, and which JD himself claims to support, was put to a vote on the Senate floor. JD Vance was a no-show. **Instead, he was posing for photos at the southern border.** Vance claims to be a supporter of families and kids. He's even claimed he supports the child tax credit. But just like so many other Republican promises, JD Vance is all talk with no real action to back it up. If he cared as much about helping working families as he does cheap political stunts, he would've at least used his platform to convince his Republican colleagues to support the bill. The truth is, JD Vance is just another phony Republican politician. [**We can do without one in the White House, and we can certainly do with fewer of them in Congress. Aside from the obvious reality that the Democratic agenda – chock full of initiatives like paid family and sick leave, tackling the housing crisis, and defending IVF – is the most pro-family agenda around, it's Vance's hypocrisy that never fails to surprise. He talks a big game about the importance of family and how government should be doing more to encourage people to start families, but when it comes down to taking action to support families? He's nowhere to be found. What gives? Earlier this year, my proposal to expand the Child Tax Credit, a proven success in helping lift kids out of poverty, and which JD himself claims to support, was put to a vote on the Senate floor. JD Vance was a no-show. Instead, he was posing for photos at the southern border. Vance claims to be a supporter of families and kids. He's even claimed he supports the child tax credit. But just like so many other Republican promises, JD Vance is all talk with no real action to back it up. If he cared as much about helping working families as he does cheap political stunts, he would've at least used his platform to convince his Republican colleagues to support the bill. name: Katrina
subject: Supporting Working Parents and Building a Better Future
body:
Join me in honoring working parents and helping families thrive. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b1b279791950/supporting-working-parents-and-building-a-better-future?e=830e7edf7b)
---
|
---
[](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=507cc9d9bf&e=830e7edf7b)
|
---
| Dear ,
Today, on **Working Parents Day,** I’m reflecting on the unique challenges that working parents face—and the policies we need to better support them. As a mother who had my first child at 15 in order to become emancipated and pursue education as a path out of poverty, I understand firsthand the delicate balance between working to provide for your family and giving your children the time and care they deserve. I went on to start my own marketing agency while raising my children, but I know the struggle doesn't end with one success.
In 2021, during the "Great Resignation," I became deeply concerned about the number of women leaving the workforce due to childcare challenges. In fact, nearly **2 million women** left the workforce during the pandemic, making up the majority of those leaving jobs ([RAND Analysis](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=8fefe70e07&e=830e7edf7b)). These issues not only hurt families but also impact our economy. When women are sidelined, we lose out on the innovation they bring to critical industries like technology and artificial intelligence.
Research shows that investing in early childhood education (ECE) provides a significant return on investment. Nobel laureate James Heckman's studies demonstrate that high-quality early childhood programs yield a **13% ROI** per year by improving children's education, health, and future employment, while reducing societal costs like crime and welfare dependency ([The Heckman Equation](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=fbd6ec7546&e=830e7edf7b)). Supporting working parents with accessible childcare and preschool programs increases labor participation, especially for women, strengthening our economy.
Utah prides itself on being a family-first state, but the reality is, Utah has ranked **last** in women’s equality for the past decade. We have some of the largest gender disparities in areas like education, income, and leadership opportunities([KSLNewsRadio](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=8b8e483b01&e=830e7edf7b))([UPR](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=8561a9a40e&e=830e7edf7b)). This isn’t just unacceptable—it’s a call to action. As a state that claims to care so much about families, we must do better.
That’s why I decided to run for Congress. I want to champion policies that give working parents the support they need—affordable childcare, paid family leave, and educational opportunities that help all families thrive. Together, we can create a Utah that truly supports its families and gives every parent the chance to succeed.
Thank you for your continued support, and let’s keep working toward a brighter future for all Utah families.
---

---
| | Best wishes, warmest regards,
**Katrina Fallick-Wang** _Candidate for Congress, Utah’s 4th District_

# Democrats Deliver in the Senate, Help Defend in 2024
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2us6in-exguvm-kyd76rh4/)
---
**Four Battleground States: Ohio, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Montana.** Defending the Senate is crucial for making real progress on key issues such as abortion, climate change, and Social Security. The leadership of dedicated Democrats like Sherrod Brown in Ohio, Bob Casey in Pennsylvania, Tammy Baldwin in Wisconsin, and Jon Tester in Montana is essential to advancing policies that benefit all Americans. **Abortion Rights** : With ongoing threats to reproductive rights, it is more important than ever to have senators who will fight to protect a woman’s right to choose. Democratic senators have consistently stood up against efforts to roll back these rights and will continue to do so if we maintain control of the Senate. **Climate Change** : Addressing the climate crisis requires bold action and committed leadership. Senators like Tammy Baldwin, who serves on the climate change committee, have been at the forefront of promoting sustainable policies that protect our environment and create green jobs. Keeping these leaders in the Senate ensures continued progress on this critical issue that affects every state, industry, and citizen. **Social Security** : Protecting Social Security is vital for the well-being of millions of Americans. Democratic senators have been champions of preserving and strengthening this crucial safety net. Leaders like Sherrod Brown have introduced legislation to ensure the longevity and reliability of Social Security for future generations. These senators have shown unwavering commitment to these and other important issues, and now we need to have their backs going into one of the most contentious elections in recent history. Sherrod Brown, Bob Casey, Tammy Baldwin, and Jon Tester have proven their dedication to fighting for the rights and well-being of their constituents. Their leadership is essential for bringing our nation to a better place. [**You can make a real difference today by contributing to ALL FOUR battleground states with one donation. It is crucial that each of these Dems maintain their seats for at least another term, and we would love to give you the opportunity to contribute to these efforts.**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2us6in-exguvn-kyd76rh5/)

# Army Combat Veteran Running for Congress in Nevada
---
LAS VEGAS (April 10, 2024)--Retired Army Colonel Mark Robertson is running for U.S. Congress in Nevada's First Congressional District. Robertson enlisted in the Army as a Private, then rose through the ranks to eventually retire as a Colonel. He was deployed to ten foreign countries, including Afghanistan, Iraq, Kuwait, and Syria combat zones.
Nevada's First Congressional District includes Boulder City, most of Henderson, and the parts of Las Vegas and Clark County east of Interstate 15. Robertson raised his family in this district and has strong ties to the community.
Robertson joined the Army at age 17, just after graduating high school. He completed basic training at Fort Jackson, SC. Many years later, Robertson returned to Ft. Jackson and commanded the same company to which he was assigned as a Private. His son would later join the Army and was assigned to the same training battalion.
Robertson and his son, Sergeant Steve Robertson, deployed to Iraq at the same time in 2010-2011. Robertson says, "It was an honor to serve with my son, but it was terrifying for my wife. She flew a flag with two blue stars outside our house for the year we were deployed." In recognition of his service in Iraq, Robertson received the Bronze Star.
Having served in the enlisted and officer ranks, Robertson is uniquely qualified to represent the Veterans in his district. He comes from a military family where both his parents served in the Navy. His dad was a Corpsman attached to the Marine Corps. Robertson understands the issues facing veterans. "I have a lot of respect and love for the men and women who sacrificed to serve our Nation," Robertson says.
When asked why he is running for Congress, Robertson said, "This is not something I ever thought I would do, but I don't like the direction of our country and want to help things get better." In addition to his 30 years of military service, Robertson owned a small business in Henderson. He has a degree in finance from BYU and an MBA. He taught finance at UNLV. "I know how the economy works and how to balance a budget," he said.
Robertson has experience in Washington, D.C. He served in the Pentagon, was on the faculty of the National Defense University, and was a delegate to the Global Coalition Against ISIS. His military awards include the Legion of Merit, Defense Meritorious Service Medal, Airborne Badge, and Good Conduct Medal.
People can learn more about Robertson at his campaign website, [www.RobertsonForCongress.com](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0011b1qx1ZxGO6xO92QnbnTjSjD-CZpR_bpoCQ0R72mSWCEK6zCwH7fYWfjXmYZYxBZwAyfUvjUj6pY_I0ZAQgyJhwb0JWD2hIFIFxs8lTIXZk0kqfLIEOR_2CyFpHn710jJrlw3cLINkNz4kvzg19qmGJsVn8ERk9h0HvMrAVZ0vc=&c=TmNBB45CQcDxjLKiHE3D_6k4N-NSwkGyHVKhIvw5nUifiMAcOUjQQw==&ch=31fJZ3k2Ia2c_tUaLzzaHPotmLzrBhn_g4PQiH8Vr57LN9qjr8ZRyA==)
Please forward this email to your friends and neighbors and encourage them to support Mark Robertson in his fight to take back our country.

Earlier this year, the Las Vegas Review Journal asked Mark three questions that they were going to include in their Voter Guide publication. Below, are Mark's replies to two of the questions. Q. How will you appeal to Nevada's nonpartisan voters? A. For the past 32 years, I have worked, played, served, and worshipped with the people in my district regardless of any party affiliation. They know me, and I know them. Through my work with nonprofit organizations such as Opportunity Village, the Salvation Army, and Veteran groups, I have formed friendships with people of all races, religions, national origins, and economic statuses. As a Certified Financial Planner, I worked with teachers, first responders, hotel service workers, blue-collar workers, and people from all walks of life. As a Congressman, I will be loyal to the Constitution and the people of my district. Q. What would be your top three priorities, if elected, and what specific actions will you take to get them done? A. 1. Sponsor legislation to secure our border to stop the flow of guns, gangs, and drugs into our communities, followed by immigration reform that only allows people into our country with the skills we need and who will not require government assistance. 2. Fight to return regular order to our budgeting process, thus controlling spending on our way to a balanced budget. 3. Introduce legislation to protect parents' right to choose which school is best for their child while reducing or eliminating the federal government's role in education. Education funds should follow the child.

save Ted Cruz and Rick Scott

Let's recap a few things, friend.

**[First,](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b1b7cb481b36429295fc910d8ef09c50&_e=YMM7v1mrkqNVr2FbcaMUiIfiuUCDTOPlZpXs7MhOJO2Es-l5Kh2_MkAHlJJ0k2PRXVGpII-oEGbwldCq-khrz6Zez_W2WcJTZQDEiD9Clsv1jE3WM4cex5TW17HKDOlPdyKQlB9U6OU2fXM5bWXfWAha9a_OEXb2A-2DapDI2xoeOyi20L2T8RWwDvJixCZmIyU45Hufrl9fNLECPhDTevI8-mMGa9p4WrHfId_-S6dZe---2TFh_Y9Doc78gjJMf29CxoK6ljYvxl401famKE13D4Yqy_TAtnf2u_1XfiztHVsaZWrCb2JMNWk04JsqvuOqqv90tbLAv2cL6zSOnic1p0aEDiBFNo-xbAdOFZOj06ZZruO6YJTSv-F6jESYiYgBb_-MWn2urPv1dxdf4uNY9v86V0mo4OwTp4fqvtCXVBptmhSUDsj27yts8EcskG7wxa2Lf3NMnL1Kp64iJX0bwctACf9JoevYHGlwpTgLOSRKEN5vrtjLHT-PbeuL) **the number of Americans identifying as Republicans hit its lowest point in YEARS.

**[Then,](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b1b7cb481b36429295fc910d8ef09c50&_e=YMM7v1mrkqNVr2FbcaMUiIfiuUCDTOPlZpXs7MhOJO2Es-l5Kh2_MkAHlJJ0k2PRXVGpII-oEGbwldCq-khrz6Zez_W2WcJTZQDEiD9Clsv1jE3WM4cex5TW17HKDOlPdyKQlB9U6OU2fXM5bWXfWAha9a_OEXb2A-2DapDI2xoeOyi20L2T8RWwDvJixCZmIyU45Hufrl9fNLECPhDTevI8-mMGa9p4WrHfId_-S6dZe---2TFh_Y9Doc78gjJMf29CxoK6ljYvxl401famKE13D4Yqy_TAtnf2u_1XfiztHVsaZWrCb2JMNWk04JsqvuOqqv90tbLAv2cL6zSOnic1p0aEDiBFNo-xbAdOFZMew_k3_C1Ej-Jq8uJLvNx0Kb61d3p_vI7nf8jSjLZ_ga5sAkRv_aFr79raK_qf7w9WdUq6Ef3I2P8OSuJ3Q23alDhd_UearrZ0cWQXdD18tNwJ-e9SDzHgIRd3ipwcI8I3y2aUP-9Taty3QZmTMfhN)** Democrats raised __**[half a billion dollars](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b1b7cb481b36429295fc910d8ef09c50&_e=YMM7v1mrkqNVr2FbcaMUiIfiuUCDTOPlZpXs7MhOJO2Es-l5Kh2_MkAHlJJ0k2PRXVGpII-oEGbwldCq-khrz6Zez_W2WcJTZQDEiD9Clsv1jE3WM4cex5TW17HKDOlPdyKQlB9U6OU2fXM5bWXfWAha9a_OEXb2A-2DapDI2xoeOyi20L2T8RWwDvJixCZmIyU45Hufrl9fNLECPhDTevI8-mMGa9p4WrHfId_-S6dZe---2TFh_Y9Doc78gjJMf29CxoK6ljYvxl401famKE13D4Yqy_TAtnf2u_1XfiztHVsaZWrCb2JMNWk04JsqvuOqqv90tbLAv2cL6zSOnic1p0aEDiBFNo-xbAdOFZMSU4vZ-k0dToyz56a1KngRMfU3mnT-OxRDOeAHjqcoJ5Uq5Vf-23GJy6ngTCCMhX0lX7vhbSQ3Mha7G4RCfVkLVayOIaKJSW3WfFsXMMX6f0lfiptzXkYINJNHiJqTi19Eul3VC3zNrMWwXZPYRu18)**__ *and* Democrat enthusiasm reached its highest point since 2008.

**[Now,](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b1b7cb481b36429295fc910d8ef09c50&_e=YMM7v1mrkqNVr2FbcaMUiIfiuUCDTOPlZpXs7MhOJO2Es-l5Kh2_MkAHlJJ0k2PRXVGpII-oEGbwldCq-khrz6Zez_W2WcJTZQDEiD9Clsv1jE3WM4cex5TW17HKDOlPdyKQlB9U6OU2fXM5bWXfWAha9a_OEXb2A-2DapDI2xoeOyi20L2T8RWwDvJixCZmIyU45Hufrl9fNLECPhDTevI8-mMGa9p4WrHfId_-S6dZe---2TFh_Y9Doc78gjJMf29CxoK6ljYvxl401famKE13D4Yqy_TAtnf2u_1XfiztHVsaZWrCb2JMNWk04JsqvuOqqv90tbLAv2cL6zSOnic1p0aEDiBFNo-xbAdOFZMOeGuQMyQm3jfRO41W3PMpJO-ZpPhzf7q7b4ioFbvcw_CC-ZD-C2s63TvYaw70N-YWQTPYwW7ZAfFXEjOmn2Du54vNXJqH8hISD3YhY-GPlWHtVlow5StNiRpesM_k_YT6FIajOEYgBI_FFrOHoi38)** Senate Republicans in __**[must-win states](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b1b7cb481b36429295fc910d8ef09c50&_e=YMM7v1mrkqNVr2FbcaMUiIfiuUCDTOPlZpXs7MhOJO2Es-l5Kh2_MkAHlJJ0k2PRXVGpII-oEGbwldCq-khrz6Zez_W2WcJTZQDEiD9Clsv1jE3WM4cex5TW17HKDOlPdyKQlB9U6OU2fXM5bWXfWAha9a_OEXb2A-2DapDI2xoeOyi20L2T8RWwDvJixCZmIyU45Hufrl9fNLECPhDTevI8-mMGa9p4WrHfId_-S6dZe---2TFh_Y9Doc78gjJMf29CxoK6ljYvxl401famKE13D4Yqy_TAtnf2u_1XfiztHVsaZWrCb2JMNWk04JsqvuOqqv90tbLAv2cL6zSOnic1p0aEDiBFNo-xbAdOFZMhPeIaQT2avCIeKPKgcYCBTh9AKAAx7GYPByJ902_lLQxP_HYpVSlZ2ezHmj5lcOwWN-iUJNR7XdVB95SKu4VlO2jc1I-CkGQAUVvG3SiWy4Fq38eulRrLm7_L8BzmIiNV4BLiAnOszaVX9LLS-n_x)**__ are on defense.

**[In Texas,](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b1b7cb481b36429295fc910d8ef09c50&_e=YMM7v1mrkqNVr2FbcaMUiIfiuUCDTOPlZpXs7MhOJO2Es-l5Kh2_MkAHlJJ0k2PRXVGpII-oEGbwldCq-khrz6Zez_W2WcJTZQDEiD9Clsv1jE3WM4cex5TW17HKDOlPdyKQlB9U6OU2fXM5bWXfWAha9a_OEXb2A-2DapDI2xoeOyi20L2T8RWwDvJixCZmIyU45Hufrl9fNLECPhDTevI8-mMGa9p4WrHfId_-S6dZe---2TFh_Y9Doc78gjJMf29CxoK6ljYvxl401famKE13D4Yqy_TAtnf2u_1XfiztHVsaZWrCb2JMNWk04JsqvuOqqv90tbLAv2cL6zSOnic1p0aEDiBFNo-xbAdOFZOv0JA7-Fn1WJ5nDt4AIBAnRoiA6SPebzdWNS_cXYcHv6pHN4744OxJfDZRBwjwIC1pzoYWE86PGIH-CyaoooukVqhB7U4umqHGFsxoRaFT4xcG93JUSfC_6CFC2lgiVjO9RD6RvFY5ygP-uzUwQSFj)** Ted Cruz is in a close race. **[In Florida,](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b1b7cb481b36429295fc910d8ef09c50&_e=YMM7v1mrkqNVr2FbcaMUiIfiuUCDTOPlZpXs7MhOJO2Es-l5Kh2_MkAHlJJ0k2PRXVGpII-oEGbwldCq-khrz6Zez_W2WcJTZQDEiD9Clsv1jE3WM4cex5TW17HKDOlPdyKQlB9U6OU2fXM5bWXfWAha9a_OEXb2A-2DapDI2xoeOyi20L2T8RWwDvJixCZmIyU45Hufrl9fNLECPhDTevI8-mMGa9p4WrHfId_-S6dZe---2TFh_Y9Doc78gjJMf29CxoK6ljYvxl401famKE13D4Yqy_TAtnf2u_1XfiztHVsaZWrCb2JMNWk04JsqvuOqqv90tbLAv2cL6zSOnic1p0aEDiBFNo-xbAdOFZN6OM-YUDN7tp4VVIlgUfWnysWsf2BWZ88QuTT76kV-F4mgCs4QyIKJh0Se5PMbSkttrqCe1mzFsyaYeruSSR4JkncEg5Urx_Nw31dPG8riOn9ZcfqmX8Kt725D0wFOdyv4QW1QWTKauDf3pze0VmjV)** Rick Scott is in a close race too!

Friend, Labor Day is behind us. Early voting is starting. ## Secret Service Fire on Man Targeting Trump
Secret Service agents fired at a man who pointed a rifle at former President Donald Trump while he was golfing at his West Palm Beach club. [Follow live updates here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71uwyAYAJ8GNiL-gsPA0MVbuna0wHzYVNgg88VW375K58530um-ntPT55L35dNv4DDVyc-YT5gsE4ZJPWkaXQKQoCg4MUij7V2qO12dUmEeHkkk7YU1bydEHWerHtZaoRPNTnKpuRVGcD7w4RYgcBO08DFxk4ATzSFmrMftu-YdV0jlp55w3Oa60eJWxNaJ-iByJHL0bYervxGRY8knEDni8doa62utmPeFXdCRNV82FsDPK3u16BE6PVxsVy4ldzMQzZfN5_LXwP-PTyd_AwAA__8m6lo-).The suspect fled but was later [apprehended on I-95](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LuOpDAQheGnMVm1isLcAgebkPWmGyKDy-CVsZFtmum3H_XEEx_p09H_7zk_tfMubH_1warYOOu1uBfPI9QdkJxlZZRlJm4qVnVPnRxbatpqV73RFkdbU8_rsPLQ88gNDtIOuCwtY-UUIUkc665G7LF_LLxgt8haG4udZRQS2bgS0-N_dKHsbP07vjg91nhUXu2lnFk0fwRNgqbwPmMun0nQ9IEFTTgKmupW0HRlCHxnQVPeYywubJD4jKmwAV3AxKC9gZKu48ywRW9h9dcC9-48A3_BmTg7w6HArTPEAFuKVzAfsErKnLfz3uWuFxK3Qzv_c7H8Huyl6DsAAP__Wf9u8Q) in a neighboring county. He was identified as Ryan Wesley Routh.Trump was [unharmed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1urDAQQOGnMZ3R-A-WwsWVrug2SpcSDXgMExmMsLOrffsoqVOf5uj7uE935MTH-oY7-RrzhEvlB02DVJ3UdrJN8JFIk2nIq153dnDauGbzzjmzmNCHBYZgBoXgNLpeuyHenLqFhr0GbWFQnQLooW9nmqGbrcIQoYsEwgIFrvlqPzMfdaOYXvlBV7vkvUl-q_UswvwTehR6xHk56FnaNf9kocf3nLjyUoQe6_W1n7JgJImx0iXLlnPlY5U7XjLhmuWC-4m8HkKPpebrJczIQZj_SpkerAJoLh_OJ6fEpeuFhXVHTr8n9W-Xh9ffAQAA__9v5mSv), and the FBI is investigating what it calls "an apparent attempted assassination." Leaders from both parties condemned the use of violence in politics.In an e-mail, Trump [reassured followers ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O6yAUBp8GOiL-jJ2C4jbuctstrWNzMKwwWEAc5e1X2XrrT9-MNF-P5QExxbz_hwNt92WBrccLlzsThkm9aOqsR5SoKFoxSqPvg1QDDXbYzGo8CCUmpRABgQ_KjX4QehrATTRayaXmd2EE5yMfbyuu3KxagPPceOREc3Sxl3r7LjH3gD69y4X1tpWDJht6PxtR_4iciZx7wBBT-mxEzqEcmPHViJw3OE6IeyZy1tMkBNes1-dxsgbvxgKyV0yJZbywsvasFbPDysB3rKziWWpHx_ZnbqH0D49W687PJzYzEs33A-Kvlva_A11W_gQAAP___vNqPQ)he was safe. _" Nothing will slow me down,"_ he wrote. _"I will NEVER SURRENDER! I will always love you for supporting me. "_ This incident follows an assassination attempt two months ago when Trump was shot and wounded at a Pennsylvania rally.
## IRS Whistleblowers Sue Hunter Biden's Attorney
IRS whistleblowers Gary Shapley and Joseph Ziegler have [filed a $20 million defamation lawsuit](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAURb8Gb1hAsB0PDF28pWtH62Ee8aswRECM8vdVMne_9-jo_NzWG1CgeP-GA031aYWt0onrzOXIlV5154xHVHjp0MhJjXoe1GXodgM4D3AdtZhwkJu0V78hCrAK3aalg46MEkqLWY5SiElMvUUrRqslOC9Gj4JpgY5qyv1volh39OGVTsz9lo4umL3WR2GXL6YWppbWWh-hUooQMp6E7T1jaonYClML5cLbTqUGtCE1zIV7CsiV4AeFQClyhx6OD4IHaOVJlcMdKJbK92esmLklh5FDrSlHfDG1dNm4R3v_yzgxLe4HUPj41f9rnUb9BQAA__9oCHGx) against Hunter Biden's attorney, Abbe Lowell.They allege Lowell falsely accused them of criminal acts after they testified that the Department of Justice gave preferential treatment to President Biden's son during an investigation into international business affairs.Lowell responded by claiming Shapley and Ziegler [violated grand jury secrecy rules](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO4yAURb8Gd1gYExwXFNmV3GWlraa0IDyHl8GQgZeg_P0oU091r3Sao_NxXs8WI6brP7uDoS2v9kL4hHXmg-ZSrarzZgOQMHZghklqNR_keOiCEU550GCdlsqL6WC1O6p5HmA8egXedWikkErMgx6EmMTUO3BCOzVYvwm9gWBKgEfKpb9lTBRgi6_8hNJf8t5FE4julY0nJhcml9Zav9f0ZkwukPijMrkkaO-554iEl_fFUnkLWCmCi7lBqTwg8fBIBIU79JB45ZYolwQv3pAC3-0tF-5hs7slzIlH2-oDicnFFn46DV9__n_-7Yrx94YxYtUTU-K6W4w_rvR7uaeR3wEAAP__ue50NA) and taxpayer protection laws--what the lawsuit names as an act of "clear malice" that has tarnished the plaintiffs' reputations.
## Polaris Dawn Returns to Earth
Space X's Polaris Dawn crew returned safely to Earth early Sunday morning, splashing down in Crew Dragon _Resilience_ off the coast of Dry Tortugas, Florida. [Photos are here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2T2yAQQH8N6tYDGCO7oEij7tKm9KxgkUj40LDIzv37TK6-6nVv3rxfH88PTDnV7ScWciO2J_qRXvR8gLKgzdNMwUUiTdeJnJq1NY-bvt6m3eGMPoSAK2pLRoX5fpfr_WrNPaq42jAlp6U28qGsknKW82WlVdrVKAxR2khSGEkhjdYvv1uqY6eYP9uL-sW3MmW3j3GwuP4QehF6qfTmC-P4om9F6OW_XuhFPoRe1E3o5c8ZGsNowAd6-gtrT3VLdQMqsLdCwBgpfwIyHC1jTwwB35XBt1Ko-4QZkEdvFc_B0GmcvULsrQCf3hNzPDOUxJxaFXqZugvHO-Wc2M7CyK1gyl_14_uXL6f_BQAA__-2OHps)The mission made history by performing the first commercial spacewalk and reaching the highest orbit since the Apollo 17 moon mission in 1972.Crew member and violinist Sarah Gillis released a music video during the mission. Her space performance, sent to Earth via satellite, is accompanied by orchestras worldwide. Mike Soboleski Launches Maine Issues & Action PAC
Friends,
I'm so happy to announce my latest project. I've created a Political Action Committee to support and continue the legislative victories that we had last session. The Maine Issues & Action PAC, MiaPAC for short, will make a positive impact on Maine public policy hoping to make Mainers' lives easier and more affordable.
MiaPAC's mission statement reads,
"Maine Issues & Action PAC was founded to identify the problems facing Maine and to take action to fix them. Often these issues are caused by short sighted policy proposals from elected officials or bureaucratic overreach from unelected state agencies. MIA PAC has successfully fought to stop these policies that hurt Mainers and will continue to do so."
In my first term I was able to achieve several solid policy victories to build on for the 132nd legislature. Ultimately, no one can do this alone and expect to continue to succeed. I created MiaPAC with the hope that it can be a beacon for the public to know what's really going on in Augusta. I want MiaPAC to be there for them to rally around to stop bad policy from becoming law. I also want to protect our business community from bad legislation and over regulation. MiaPAC will be there for them as well.
MiaPAC has an experienced team that works every day to analyze and evaluate the policies that impact Mainers' lives. MiaPAC will engage in grassroots advocacy and legislative work that I am hoping will be a great resource for my colleagues in the legislature. I am so excited to begin this new chapter of work for the people of Maine.
The Maine Issues & Action PAC can be found at our website (www.maineissuesandaction.org) as well as on Facebook and X. In the 132nd Legislature MiaPAC will be tracking the following issues: Office of New Americans, Paid Family Medical Leave, Triad Weed, Parental Rights, Exposing Government Corruption and Reducing State Spending among others. If you are able, please donate to fund our important work today.
Thank you and I can't wait to get back to work!
Mike

The Maine Issues & Action PAC, MiaPAC for short, will make a positive impact on Maine public policy hoping to make Mainers' lives easier and more affordable. MiaPAC's mission statement reads, "Maine Issues & Action PAC was founded to identify the problems facing Maine and to take action to fix them. Often these issues are caused by short sighted policy proposals from elected officials or bureaucratic overreach from unelected state agencies. MIA PAC has successfully fought to stop these policies that hurt Mainers and will continue to do so." In my first term I was able to achieve several solid policy victories to build on for the 132nd legislature. Ultimately, no one can do this alone and expect to continue to succeed. I created MiaPAC with the hope that it can be a beacon for the public to know what's really going on in Augusta. I want MiaPAC to be there for them to rally around to stop bad policy from becoming law. I also want to protect our business community from bad legislation and over regulation. MiaPAC will be there for them as well. MiaPAC has an experienced team that works every day to analyze and evaluate the policies that impact Mainers' lives. MiaPAC will engage in grassroots advocacy and legislative work that I am hoping will be a great resource for my colleagues in the legislature. I am so excited to begin this new chapter of work for the people of Maine. The Maine Issues & Action PAC can be found at our website (www.maineissuesandaction.org) as well as on Facebook and X. In the 132nd Legislature MiaPAC will be tracking the following issues: Office of New Americans, Paid Family Medical Leave, Triad Weed, Parental Rights, Exposing Government Corruption and Reducing State Spending among others. If you are able, please donate to fund our important work today. Thank you and I can't wait to get back to work! ## Texas Tops AP Poll, Unseats Georgia at No. 1
The University of Texas claimed the [No. 1 spot in the AP Top 25 college football](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j72OwjAQBp8m7oJ2N_6JCxfX0HHtldHa3oAlQ6LECtzbn6C_8vumGM3PZbpwqeVx_ea7hPaal4lTK4dMvkfbk560yiFC9qgkoCOrR4-o1S2METBFthYIneXkLMV5QLGeJXskVQIBafBoEYwd8OSIR-BsDSTWQKbTILm0ZTu1mzR58T7X3-WQ7ZSWu6rh1tq6d8NXR-eOzrw-5Lm_0XtsraQqn7tvy9qT6Q2g80KJRyAPcxrRo2fOkSOx8YPaQl6fpdayW9dpuN651I-q_VN-BPoLAAD__1EZWBk) poll for the first time in 16 years, dethroning Georgia. The move comes after Longhorns backup QB Arch Manning replaced Quinn Ewers in Saturday's game against UTSA, [throwing for four touchdowns](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOqzAQRb8GuonswRgoXLyGLq_dEg32ELwyJrIdSPbrV0m_9b06Ojpf1-lKPvh4-08bm_Jc9ols8QdPA0gNqCZVOzMLN8iajexQq36QUtWr0YvEWbq2sYpmVIOwfesabTstLfWItTcoUIlBaila3chLh9QLcroVlpTAtlKCnS97upSVCz8pL-G1H5wudt_qYNZS7rlq_lU4VjjOgcmunBLf91TelwpHSsXbwLnCUQrZtEoI-JCAkl1hoxh9vMHGeePkfziDXWZYKGY4fVmhheIy-Ainj3BkeJRMQEvhBHxyek_fj_Sqk3H304fgs-4qJW4b-fCxLH9EOwz-BgAA__8FXXDV) and running for another--a 67-yard scramble, the longest by a Texas quarterback since Vince Young in 2005. Meanwhile, Georgia eked out a 13-12 win against the unranked Kentucky Wildcats. The Longhorns received [35 first-place votes and 1,540 points](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OqzAQxfGngW6QbYyBwsVt0uW2W6IJ_sBawyB7kk3efpX025-fdPT_ui5XTDkd8T_u3vIz0IIrp4dfZpAGlF506-xNuFm23spRGT3NUup2s0GFVaMSYVhdr8UwynGWo-5nPaw3E3SbrBJKi1kaKQbTy25UOAl0ZhAraqGGRgvvElPpePPsn1hDftHDl26lvc12Yz5r0_9r1KVRl3pS4dq9cCN6Dxp1wROYTlADfDS8LeO3rxA9lZgQAhU4CCTUkxgwsC-Q6YgblaOCoz0dyB5u95wdxQqVyz3G7EFOyvSTMnO38Z7bYt35k3JO1YyNFnHHlD8v-Y9oD6t-AwAA__9M-3DN), while Georgia fell to No. 2 with 23 first-place votes and 1,518 points.
## High-Speed Rail Authority Proposed
North Texas officials are proposing the creation of a [statewide high-speed rail authority](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LHO4yAQBOCnwR0WrME2BcU17nLtlRaBdUAiYMFenHv7U9L_9TcjjebPbb-5lFN5_HZPtPQ-6u48pRfuhsuZg9rVEOxdBCMHtHKBWa1GSjVEi7hO90OLMGkjgwSx6NX7aTkUrsJoOSQLApQwcpZCz5McF3CrcGHWwjslQDMlMCSqbaSIhG_Xj_yvvrCNvj6HbCPR2dn0i8HGYLuua_Sx1fJRBlvBqzPYYv3bqRb-7TPYqLnSz9rIUaqFweYaJZ_xQ58Ij-kReT8RA28uZU7NpcKlWWYttBrPeA7NhvNKOac-L0yJx9Ol_N1EP1z0svA_AAD__07Mabc) with the power of eminent domain to facilitate the acquisition of land needed for a planned bullet train route between Houston and Dallas. Although the Texas Supreme Court ruled in 2022 that the private company behind the project has eminent domain authority, proponents of the new high-speed rail authority say it's needed [to speed up securing property](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FuwyAQQL_GbFhwnLE9MHTJlq4drQscMSqJI0NN2q-vmr37e3p6H-flTCmn-_WdbuzqM24L-ZoOXmaprQRcUAR3UWHWgp0eweI0a41idQNGjCp6tP4yeVJszDh5DFoDeMIokgMFqGZttRqs0f0INCkKdlCeUMHQoeKQ6rb3deXKTyoxf28H773fbiK7tdZH6cxbB6cOTq21_s6tNObPP6CD08uRa7qusjyYg9wpZZnpHmTh9PO1c5F6HowBI3YXHi3lnIodO1TXG6X86tR_tg8HvwEAAP__oQ9aqw) along the 240-mile route. Central Texas Railway currently owns about 30% of the land needed for the project, but it was recently sued for [delinquent property taxes](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OrCAYxvGrwe41gIhSUJzGbk67pXlFVDIIE2D8uPvNbrbaZMtfnubJ_-MxPtB5F9b_uFtdriWOaIo77KiASeBiFNWsJzorVlnNOi5FrxgT1aZN30xtP7EOGyMFVXIxTCk5iV7NFPlSOc0pF1QxyWgrG1Z3HHuKs2ypQUF5SwS1sysx1WWzxV6YF3_Hw6baxL3yeivllUnzj_CB8OE8z_p5XcfXSPgQ7JkJH3w06OEHLsAd3wmCdes2xbTFOBM-rMntNoOJ71Du3wYFsWw2ZchvCwmdBxP3F4Yblpigb-kTXIAJzRMKXjZXSc-v03nvsuyIoOuOzn8_Ln8EPDT_DAAA__8Cx3Wt) in ten counties. High-Speed Rail Authority Proposed North Texas officials are proposing the creation of a with the power of eminent domain to facilitate the acquisition of land needed for a planned bullet train route between Houston and Dallas. Although the Texas Supreme Court ruled in 2022 that the private company behind the project has eminent domain authority, proponents of the new high-speed rail authority say it's needed along the 240-mile route. Central Texas Railway currently owns about 30% of the land needed for the project, but it was recently sued for in ten counties. The high-speed rail project, developed in partnership with Amtrak, received a $63.9 million federal funding boost earlier this month. Its total anticipated cost has meanwhile increased from $10 billion to $33.4 billion. # [Tell Republicans to join Democrats in condemning violence instead of promoting it](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9b91d144-8340-461d-a21a-92ebb348eb18/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | When Donald Trump was once again threatened by a potential assassin, Democrats across the nation were quick to condemn the act, and political violence overall. President Biden and VP Harris had statements out within minutes. But when Nancy Pelosi's husband was viciously attacked by a hammer-wielding assailant, Donald Trump and other Republican leaders used it to get laughs at rallies, and fan the flames of even more violent acts. And they're praising the January 6th violent criminals as "heroes." In short, they're not fighting violence, they're trying to foment more of it. Enough is enough. Republicans need to join with Democrats in condemning violence, and if they don't, they need to be called out, and where appropriate, prosecuted and jailed. [**Please join with us, add your name, and tell Republicans to join Democrats in condemning violence instead of promoting it.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc917b7bd-efb9-4e11-aaa0-a1bc9e1a3219/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---

_" I grew up as the 9th of 10 children in Greensboro. My father was an alcoholic who beat my mother. He died when I was in the fifth grade, and I was terrified. He had been the sole provider for our household. I remember sitting on the porch wondering where I'd be in five years.

Would I be in a shelter? In foster care? Would I be separated from my brothers and sisters?

A few days after my father died, my mom's friend came by. She explained that now that her husband was gone, _my mother could kick her feet up and relax because the government would take care of everything._

**But that wasn 't my mom. **

As soon as her friend left, she got up and walked over to the local university and got a job as a janitor. She had a fifth-grade education and five kids to provide for. She chose to clean up for other kids to provide for her own. **She didn 't just rise to the challenge, she excelled.**"_
Mark Robinson is North Carolina's first black lieutenant governor running to be the first black governor of North Carolina. This race is adding up to be nearly $80 MILLION in television ads. That doesn't include the attacks liberals will launch by mail, by phone, and by radio ads!

| | **U.S. Senate Race in Florida — September Toplines**
---
**INTERNAL MEMORANDUM**
---
**DATE:** Sept. 16, 2024
**CANDIDATE:** Debbie Mucarsel-Powell (DMP)
**FOR:** DMP HQ, Team Debbie
---
**GENERAL:**
---
* DMP continues her 75-stop statewide tour, one stop for every time Rick Scott pled the fifth in his Medicare fraud case.

---
* Rick Scott was backstage with Donald Trump at the debate against Vice President Kamala Harris; **both men have since REFUSED to debate their Democratic opponents in the wake of Trump's disastrous performance.**

---
* As the race heats up, DMP has launched her **first statewide English and Spanish TV ads** of the general election.

---
|
---
**BATTLEGROUND POLLING:**
---

Your tripled contribution could make all the difference, so please >>
| | | Friend, it's Martin Sheen. **I'll try to keep this brief.

My friends at the DSCC are doing everything they can to save our razor-thin Democratic Senate majority, and with just 50 days left before the election, every little bit helps. [So can I count on you to chip in $5 _(matched to become $15)_ to defend the Senate?](https://go.dscc.org/go/19847?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20240916-MartinSheen-SheenXDaysFR-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20240916-MartinSheen-SheenXDaysFR-Pros-sl1&akid=17385%2E9716520%2EfhF_wY)**

As an activist, I know that **the greatest American victories of our time rarely came all at once.** They were the culmination of years or even decades of work, all with the goal of making our country a little more perfect -- one seemingly small act at a time.

But I also know there were many moments along the way when victory and defeat stood together on a knife's edge: A 5-4 decision in the Supreme Court, a tie-breaking vote in the Senate, an election decided by just a handful of votes.

Another such moment is before us in 50 days.

Will it yield a victory for Senate Democrats, who've fought fiercely to defend our rights and our democracy? Or defeat at the hands of Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans, who attack the legitimacy of our elections, raise taxes on hardworking Americans, and threaten the rights and freedoms we hold dear?

The experts say that enough races to decide Senate control are toss-ups. Now, we can pore over polls all day long, but I think the truth is a lot simpler: **You and I will decide what happens here. In these final weeks of the campaign, everything we do could make the difference. And that's why I'm asking for your help.**

| | Happy Monday! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! There are only __**50 days**__ until Election Day. As I warned in my update last week, the attacks against Tom and our campaign are heating up. This past week, our opponent's campaign began a **_$1,000,000_** ad spend against us, flooding the airwaves with their lies. While we are up on the air pushing back, we can beat them on the ground too. I am asking for you to step up and chip into our mission by volunteering some time to call voters or knock on doors. It takes all of us to get over the line this November 5th. This past week, Tom returned to Washington to work on your behalf after the end of the District work period. Upon his return to the district, he participated in events across three counties on Saturday - including stopping by a door knocking launch to thank volunteers, cultural festivals, and community events. __**Did you see Tom at all this weekend? Send us your pictures with Tom if you did!**__ Our Field Team doubled down on our Get Out The Vote (GOTV) universe, and launched some of our new volunteers from last week's recruitment efforts. We spent the week contacting voters at both our phone banks and door launches. We honored those we lost on 9/11 during the middle of the week and reflected on how our country came together with a sense of pride and patriotism after that fateful day. Please be on alert! If you are a vote-by-mail voter, __ballots in New Jersey will begin to be mailed out this coming Saturday, September 21st__. In my next edition of this newsletter, I'll have everything you need for voting resources outlined for you to use or share with friends. Every vote counts - be prepared and ready to vote! We are proud of our efforts over these past few months. While the weeks ahead will feel long, I am confident that with your help, November 5th will be a great day for all of NJ-07. _**Are you ready to work hard to deliver Republican victories in November, and send Tom Kean, Jr. back to Congress? To get involved,[please visit our website](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=a4f8300ef2604cf8b0877b86d263acd1&_e=rXjAsxLlrAGqizQ5QxHiGnnetEqm5Iq2XZ8ViORHwVxPnVP5BjlRAVQ7c2FxdMxwLLuYJrLofytvyQJTQZS2VNDfFWe8MbwvGyLjtKrzfpHhFOdyicUNifGrFaxLpFV0J6xg5e3Nj90jdRd6sTXVJGcEs0UmDuuQzMlRSYsof4dvgY5Jia9QKNfJPn7OKHuSoKtLvMDOkfcG1bJzM_JfNlf-ej8QxeQwmTTFGklA260%3D).**_ Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! | | **Kean's Bill to Improve Artificial Intelligence Literacy for K-12 Passes Committee **
---
| | On Wednesday, Tom's bill the _[_Literacy in Future Technologies (LIFT) Artificial Intelligence Act_](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=a4f8300ef2604cf8b0877b86d263acd1&_e=rXjAsxLlrAGqizQ5QxHiGp7a2vVngwzjqdew6bm-ykLudO5589cMJ_bvkcEVS9ijRsdacc41DjE0SXuzGwZqOKJo8_4Ip5-QqTm9oB21dIWrQcojUTGEVi6I66JEUiFeHCpb7yJ69o_oFlUL4RcmefeaoSIDcju_KahrUqTNGnntYtlDzWr77OyFaqxIKSuCemg4AhAWUiIZdV-kceaV8Ppv16XJu0lvz8ShYnwV3sEvaHuTW_sGPMOO4ytoFZYxdTzU9JjL-EdHYZsKQPlfq3tkfWx-fpO1K5201iMiJ7thR6xbBZ_GXakOFlUd7M6c)_ , which would improve artificial intelligence literacy for K-12, was passed by the Science, Space and Technology Committee. The LIFT AI Act would support the development of AI literacy curriculum and evaluation methods for K-12 through an NSF grant program, focusing on learner-centered, project-based, and adaptable educational materials. Provide professional learning opportunities for educators and promote the integration of hands-on AI tools into existing curriculums, along with evaluation methods to assess proficiency.
“Early childhood understanding of AI will have positive spillover impacts in our everyday life, work productivity, and social circles. Proficient understanding of AI will mitigate negative impacts of this technology, specifically in the AI generated content space. To ensure our children succeed in the field of AI, we need to start preparing them early in the classroom.” \- _**Congressman Tom Kean, Jr.**_

**Tom Kean Jr.** is the proud husband to Rhonda, and the proud father to two daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful town of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom’s dedication and commitment to public service was inspired at a young age by his grandfather who served in the U.S. House of Representatives, and his father who served as Governor of New Jersey. Throughout Tom’s life, he has followed in their footsteps while setting forth his own path of public service—now serving as a first-term **Congressman for New Jersey’s 7th District.** **_Kean's mission is simple:_**** For New Jersey. clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Happy Monday! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! There are only 50 days until Election Day. As I warned in my update last week, the attacks against Tom and our campaign are heating up. This past week, our opponent's campaign began a $1,000,000 ad spend against us, flooding the airwaves with their lies. While we are up on the air pushing back, we can beat them on the ground too. I am asking for you to step up and chip into our mission by volunteering some time to call voters or knock on doors. It takes all of us to get over the line this November 5th. This past week, Tom returned to Washington to work on your behalf after the end of the District work period. Upon his return to the district, he participated in events across three counties on Saturday - including stopping by a door knocking launch to thank volunteers, cultural festivals, and community events. Did you see Tom at all this weekend? Send us your pictures with Tom if you did! Our Field Team doubled down on our Get Out The Vote (GOTV) universe, and launched some of our new volunteers from last week's recruitment efforts. We spent the week contacting voters at both our phone banks and door launches. We honored those we lost on 9/11 during the middle of the week and reflected on how our country came together with a sense of pride and patriotism after that fateful day. Please be on alert! If you are a vote-by-mail voter, ballots in New Jersey will begin to be mailed out this coming Saturday, September 21st. In my next edition of this newsletter, I'll have everything you need for voting resources outlined for you to use or share with friends. Every vote counts - be prepared and ready to vote! We are proud of our efforts over these past few months. While the weeks ahead will feel long, I am confident that with your help, November 5th will be a great day for all of NJ-07. Are you ready to work hard to deliver Republican victories in November, and send Tom Kean, Jr. back to Congress? To get involved,. Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! P.S.: Lawn signs are moving fast, to request a Kean for Congress lawn sign now while you can! | | | | | | | Kean's Bill to Improve Artificial Intelligence Literacy for K-12 Passes Committee | | On Wednesday, Tom's bill the , which would improve artificial intelligence literacy for K-12, was passed by the Science, Space and Technology Committee. The LIFT AI Act would support the development of AI literacy curriculum and evaluation methods for K-12 through an NSF grant program, focusing on learner-centered, project-based, and adaptable educational materials. Provide professional learning opportunities for educators and promote the integration of hands-on AI tools into existing curriculums, along with evaluation methods to assess proficiency. “Early childhood understanding of AI will have positive spillover impacts in our everyday life, work productivity, and social circles. Proficient understanding of AI will mitigate negative impacts of this technology, specifically in the AI generated content space. To ensure our children succeed in the field of AI, we need to start preparing them early in the classroom.” \- Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. | | | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | | | | | | This past week, Tom a volunteer launch at the Union County Republican HQ ahead of door knocking in Springfield , visited the Bedminster Farmers Market with Nick Cuozzo and Rocky Ganta our Somerset County Commissioner Candidates, stopped by the Branchburg Bavarian Festival, participated in Chinese-American Mid Autumn Lantern Festivals in both Bernards and Bridgewater , and attended the Bernardsville Centennial Festival - quite a bit to keep up with! In the meantime, our Field Team was busy throughout the week recruiting new volunteers, delivering yard signs, coordinating upcoming launches, and recruiting new interns (of course they were door knocking and phone banking as well!). Overall it was a great week from our Field Team and they deserve a lot of credit. Please thank them! Our door knocking program covered towns like Warren, Westfield, Green Brook, Springfield, Hackettstown, Sparta, Rahway, Summit, Bloomsbury, Flemington, Raritan Township, Lambertville, Town of Clinton, Clinton Township and more! We also are hosting launches in coordination with our county and municipal organizations in the coming weeks in Scotch Plains , Long Valley, Mountainside , Summit , Washington Township , Chester Borough, Mendham Township , Raritan Township , Washington Borough , and more. We hope to see you there. Kean for Congress continued our phone banking efforts with two organized phone banks this week! There we engaged in conversations with our targeted Get Out The Vote (GOTV) voters. This past week, we did not call voters on 9/11 out of respect for the neighbors and loved ones lost in NJ-07 on that fateful day. Despite this, we were able to call over 11,000 voters across all six counties, thanks to the work of our remote callers who call from the comfort of their own homes. We have a few more phone banks lined up in the coming weeks that you can join, and are back to our thrice weekly phone banks this week! Call for Volunteers!! The Kean for Congress team will have a significant door launch efforts in the coming weeks. Join Team Kean and local candidates as we knock on key swing-voter doors. Want to join us? Use the SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER button below and details will be provided. Want to get involved? Join us at some of our upcoming weekly events! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | 🚨 UPCOMING EVENTS 🚨 | | | | | | | | 🚨 Endorsement Alerts 🚨 | | | | While Kean for Congress did not make any new announcements, we have some HUGE endorsements in the pipeline to be released soon. Keep an eye out 👀 This week however, we celebrate the incredible support Tom has received from some of the top labor unions in NJ. "I am proud of the labor coalition we are building in NJ07. In Congress, I am partnering with some of our largest unions to bolster fair labor practices and worker safety, invest in our state’s critical infrastructure, and strengthen the prosperity of our workforce - so that all New Jerseyans have the opportunity to succeed." - Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. Follow our using this link for more endorsements to be announced in the coming days! | | | | | 🚨 Opponent Exposed! 🚨 | | Sue Altman's ties to the Chinese Communist Party have been exposed! She accepted CCP-backed funding to push their agenda and weaken America’s energy independence. While Tom spent the week standing up to China, his opponent has been standing down. This is a great way to learn the ins and outs of campaign-style politics and have a true on-the-job campaign experience. We can also offer college credits and signing service hours. subject: We hate to share bad news
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
We fell short of our mid-month fundraising goal
#

We never like sharing bad news with you, but we need to let you know that we fell short of our mid-month goal.
To be honest, this has us worried.
The end of this month is our last quarterly FEC fundraising deadline before the November elections. After this deadline, our numbers get reported publicly, meaning that both allies and adversaries will be able to see how much we’ve raised this quarter.
If we fall short, our opponents will take it as a sign of weakness that we don’t have what it takes to elect gun safety champions up and down the ballot.
Gabby and all of us here at GIFFORDS PAC know that our movement to end gun violence is stronger than ever. Now, it’s up to us to raise the resources to prove our strength.
That’s why we’ve set a new goal to raise **$15,000** by the end of the day today to help us reach the goal we missed last night.
[**Can we count on you to rush in a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC? Your support right now would make a HUGE difference.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240916-1-30&t=1&akid=8952%2E3935704%2E7sq_n6)

But what about this guy? My opponent, Eric Hansen? [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92916347/498734461/-843060894?source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.09.16_TheseGuys_B1_F1_S1_C1_30OP_N-T1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTU2NmY4Ny0zMzc0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9ekMEHLSorEDFTYYc3Uq7Wd1vUlsZL9nyuWXOUGRpqI=) **He’s who I need to beat in November to ensure Democrats retain control of the Senate.** Because it won’t just be enough to elect Kamala Harris, team. name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: I was in the hospital for three months
body:
| | | | | |
---
# **I was in the hospital for 3 months**
---
| | | | |
---
| | | | Hi folks, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important. When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition." folks, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that. Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage. Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican mega-donors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help, folks. [**_So today, I’m humbly asking: Will you split a donation between my reelection campaign and No Dem Left Behind to defend our Senate majority and prevent Republicans from rolling back the progress we’ve made expanding access to affordable health care?_**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2usbim-exlz4a-kyd76rh9/)

We made a very difficult decision this week.
We had a meeting where it became clear that if we had a bit more money, we could make a real play for additional votes in the weeks before early voting begins.
The money wasn’t in the budget. But we gave the green light.
It’s a risk. We can’t get caught short in the budget after early voting begins and before the election ends. That'd be a disaster.
But the bet we made was that if we asked, you’d come through to help fill the gap. We hope that you will — for Elissa. To keep the Senate Democratic.
[**Can you make a $3 contribution before our FEC fundraising deadline ends in a short time to help us fill the budget gap we created going after the voters we need to persuade to help Elissa win this race?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240916-1-900&t=2&akid=1936%2E135344%2EhDS1Tt)
Like we said, it was a tough call. But if there’s one thing that distinguishes this campaign from every other, it’s the people. You answer the call every single time.
\- Team Slotkin

NDFB’s endorsement speaks volumes. They are standing with us to eliminate property taxes and defend the American Dream – the freedom to own property without fear of being taxed out of it.

Since 2005, there has been a [law on the books](https://substack.com/redirect/d5bab62e-34ec-4b53-86d2-374360ae67fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Minnesota which states that in Minnesota elections, _**No connection by modem is permitted**_**.** Yet, here we are in a risk environment where there are frequent [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/11df5b4c-a819-40fc-9df9-f4c075ea3d65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)1 of potential cyber attacks and the recent exposure of a sprawling [election interference campaign ](https://substack.com/redirect/2789c231-9a24-4fc2-ab05-964a61ac6714?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)by foreign actors, and multiple Minnesota counties continue the use of modems in our elections.
Hennepin, Anoka, Washington, Rice, Cass, Stearns, and Carver Counties in Minnesota all have ES&S equipment with active modem usage. How is this possible? These counties rely upon a little known loophole to the modem ban they refer to as the "early election-results program." With the historic blessing of the Office of the Secretary of State, these counties rely on a limited exception in subd. 2 of the [statute](https://substack.com/redirect/d5bab62e-34ec-4b53-86d2-374360ae67fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) which they claim is a safe-harbor for modem usage. This "loophole"2 references the use of electronic transmission of "the accumulated tally for each device to a central reporting location . . ."

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5kYXNlbnNlLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.rzpIqB6UN0KJPl2s-yVDJDvHTlfW4lQRrA-Rlz9Gkhg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=148166737)
The Minnesota state legislature should promptly review the risks associated with continued modem usage in our elections, and remove any ambiguity that "no connection by modem is permitted" in Minnesota elections. As described below, some in the Office of the Minnesota Secretary of State's Office agree that this modem loophole should be eliminated.
| [](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F4318740d-70db-42dc-95de-491a1f726003_1088x1200.jpeg)|
---|---|---
Earlier this year, the federally funded Elections Infrastructure ISAC, issued a stern warning in a guide entitled the [Essential Guide to Election Security](https://substack.com/redirect/cb5e4bd3-ff4a-4373-9ace-a272eea62c49?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Within that guide is a [section dedicated to the risks and threats](https://substack.com/redirect/2937909f-5d27-4d06-93b8-5e7ea29d30c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the _**very same modem-based unofficial election night reporting process used in Minnesota**_.
The most daunting risk statement found in one bullet point warns of:
> **" Difficulty associated with finding, and rolling back, improper changes found after the fact." **
Wow, election officials may not even know that they've been hacked, and it may be difficult to _roll back_ these changes even if identified.
Even _more recently_ , in July of this year, the CISA and FBI issued another [warning](https://substack.com/redirect/3c458751-147c-4927-b227-10158b323ff7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that we should expect, "Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks on election infrastructure, or adjacent infrastructure that support election operations..." This report continues:
> "These low-level (DDos) attacks, which are expected to continue as we approach the 2024 U.S. general election, could disrupt the availability of some election-related functions, like voter look-up tools or **unofficial election night reporting** , during the election cycle but will not impact voting itself." (emphasis added).
Academics also agree that we must protect our elections from cyber attacks or #votehacks:
* In a 2016 Harvard University Publication, "[Why American Elections Are Flawed](https://substack.com/redirect/28bb134b-e6b2-465f-ac05-c653bfa36305?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (and How to Fix Them), the author articulates the risks of the "vulnerability of electronic records to hacking." In this author's words, this incudes the threat that "Vote counts are fiddled." Further insight calls out "vintage software" used in voting machines which makes them, "particularly vulnerable to external cyberattack by foreign powers and terrorist groups."
* In 2018, the National Academy of Sciences released a report entitled, "Securing the Vote: Protecting American Democracy." As highlighted in [Chapter 7 of this report](https://substack.com/redirect/d4282946-ea68-4c55-86e2-ce3ef7d17c83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "Unfortunately, our current system is vulnerable to internal and external threats. . . . recent events make it clear that our system of voting must evolve3 in order to also protect against external actors who wish to undermine confidence in democratic institutions. . . It is difficult to secure the electronic systems used in voting even now." This chapter concludes as follows: "If the challenges currently facing our election systems are ignored, we risk an erosion of confidence in our elections system and in the integrity of our election processes."
* In a powerfully written 2020 [article](https://substack.com/redirect/9522af41-e299-4ff0-87cc-23feb5fb580b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the Georgetown Law Technology Review, the authors lay out a sobering overview of the risks of computer-based technology: "Computer-based methods are subject to "hacking", that is, the replacement of legitimate vote-counting software with a computer program that changes (some fraction of) the votes in favor of the hacker's preferred party. Hacking can be performed remotely (even if the machines are supposedly "never connected to the Internet") and it is very difficult to detect. Voters and election administrators see nothing out of the ordinary. "
* One these same authors continues his honest exposure of these vulnarabilities in his [2023 Article](https://substack.com/redirect/4e244f67-31bb-4e62-8535-25c76ebe2813?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) entitled, "Is Internet Voting Trustworthy? The Science and the Policy Battles." I apologize for the length of this quote, but his words are so succinct:
> "Twenty-first century computers are extremely complex, with many layers of hardware and millions of lines of software. These layers are susceptible to design mistakes - bugs. Some of these bugs are exploitable security vulnerabilities that leave the compute vulnerable to attack. The attack (typically) comes in the form of unexpected input provided by the attacker, which confuses the software into running programs supplies by the attacker. These attacker-supplied programs can perform all manner of malicious acts, such as altering votes in an organized way as designed by the attacker."

As these academic articles confirm, the use of modems increases the risk of #votehacks by bad actors. Yet, the Secretary of State's _official position_ is to support the continued use of modems in elections.
I have, however, obtained EXCLUSIVE documents confirming that some level-headed members of the Office of the Secretary of State's staff actually support eliminating the modem loophole. This proposal was unearthed through a government data request which disclosed a November 22, 2022 email to David Maeda, Director of Elections for the State of Minnesota. Through a follow-up inquiry, a copy of the actual legislative proposal was obtained. Sure enough, the internal document contained a specific proposal to amend Minn. Stat. section 206.845, Subd. 2 to delete any reference to the use of modems, or electronic connections in our election process. In its place, language would be added to the statute which states, "the election judges shall transfer the record of the results by disk, tape, or other physical means of communication to the central reporting office." This legislative change would _close the modem loophole_ in Minnesota.
I will be posting a copy of the email communication and the proposed language of this statutory change for paid subscribers in a separate post. Any current member (or candidate) of the Minnesota House or Senate that is interested in co-authoring a bill to close the modem loophole can contact me, and I will provide the exact language as recommended internally by the Secretary of State's Office.
This is a known and clearly identified #votehacks risk threatening the security and integrity of our elections. The risk of using the modem-based _early election-results program_ has been identified by many of the lettered federal agencies - the Elections Infrastructure ISAC, CISA and the FBI. The vulnerability to #votehacks resulting from having internet connections in our voting system is clearly identified in publications from some of our countries most prestigious Universities - Harvard, Princeton, Georgetown, and the National Academy of Sciences.
Still pinned to the top of my Benda for Commonsense [facebook page](https://substack.com/redirect/1596f2a8-7c27-4a67-b8f3-d1de756385e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is a link to this Politico [article](https://substack.com/redirect/e11e0641-83b1-4966-a5e1-24a294233205?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) \- which describes, "The voting machine hacking threat you probably haven't heard about." Well, _now you know_ about this modem loophole, and the high security risks of #votehacks that this practice injects into the Minnesota election process.
Please, help spread the word to our elected officials and demand that they CLOSE THE MODEM LOOPHOLE.
1
As quoted in the testimony of Jean Easterly, Director of CISA, "The Office of the Director of National Intelligence's 2024 [Annual Threat Assessment ](https://www.odni.gov/index.php/newsroom/reports-publications/reports-publications-2024/3787-2024-annual-threat-assessment-of-the-u-s-intelligence-community)highlights how China, Russia, and Iran are the primary nation-state actors leveraging influence operations to target the U.S. elections process, with the aim of exploiting perceived sociopolitical divisions to undermine confidence in U.S. democratic institutions and shape public perception toward their interests. This threat is not new and was witnessed across multiple federal election cycles. America's adversaries target U.S. elections as part of their efforts to undermine U.S. global standing, sow discord inside the United States, and influence U.S. voters and decision making. CISA is committed to helping defend critical infrastructure, including election infrastructure, against the risk of foreign malign influence operations.
2
I use the term "loophole" to refer to the governments' interpretation of this statute. I have a [lawsuit pending](https://substack.com/@bendasense/p-145092740) in front of the Minnesota Supreme Court, where we are asking for a court interpretation of this statute that the transmission of early election results by modem is not authorized by this language.
3
In one of my legacy #transparencyproject articles, [Part 11](https://bendasense.substack.com/p/part-11-the-evolution-of-counting), I conclude: "In our new world of machine counting of votes, we must continue to find ways to preserve the sanctity of the ballot and the election process. _" I grew up as the 9th of 10 children in Greensboro. My father was an alcoholic who beat my mother. He died when I was in the fifth grade, and I was terrified. He had been the sole provider for our household. I remember sitting on the porch wondering where I'd be in five years.

Would I be in a shelter? In foster care? Would I be separated from my brothers and sisters?

A few days after my father died, my mom's friend came by. She explained that now that her husband was gone, _my mother could kick her feet up and relax because the government would take care of everything._

**But that wasn 't my mom. **

As soon as her friend left, she got up and walked over to the local university and got a job as a janitor. She had a fifth-grade education and five kids to provide for. She chose to clean up for other kids to provide for her own. **She didn 't just rise to the challenge, she excelled.**"_
Mark Robinson is North Carolina's first black lieutenant governor running to be the first black governor of North Carolina. This race is adding up to be nearly $80 MILLION in television ads. That doesn't include the attacks liberals will launch by mail, by phone, and by radio ads!

Patriot,

I want to introduce myself. **My name is Pat Harrigan, and I’m a Trump-Endorsed Green Beret running for Congress in North Carolina’s 10th district.**

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=6ea57a1b45be4e3a9ac9b51d2a17c44e&_e=KjZy5NawIIdKzALmDszuo7wbLW9UAkluAKS9WJ-QGaqUfIqlmS6_rv_SmgqugYlsxZUH7UqYhD26CDnqKx1gFluX4VVfi4_MlA6hzBYSL_c7h_eUuYVH8VET64PumkeCZKvlJSAiXGGCd2kR1uwIVVnF-yYFOnHUE4JxM9Nr_L7gLc9e2j3IGv4yGBw8S52ABHO0kH8-71-KiZGq7nr5Yct2h1WF-JcQxnqEWsTw1VhKM6Afe2R5fplwK8GLbitqX1ENO4zNXct93mKQN_0-kX-USK76aMtde5W5HV9hMvf9dBwdeR3m8LTNh4y-XDJPV0hWdZcEyxsFgTFddcUeqw%3D%3D)
I was born on the west coast and while growing up, split my time between San Diego and small-town Wyoming.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=6ea57a1b45be4e3a9ac9b51d2a17c44e&_e=KjZy5NawIIdKzALmDszuo7wbLW9UAkluAKS9WJ-QGaqUfIqlmS6_rv_SmgqugYlsxZUH7UqYhD26CDnqKx1gFluX4VVfi4_MlA6hzBYSL_c7h_eUuYVH8VET64PumkeCZKvlJSAiXGGCd2kR1uwIVVnF-yYFOnHUE4JxM9Nr_L7gLc9e2j3IGv4yGBw8S52A5P5SlLLyYYJlddk063-f99Uq33RRLRhURVg9betYqkXIfI37YzDaFuYv5O1IC3elgrg9cAISJQUvXzBYSEvpW78wU8d8NIg8Xd_pYpAnM6SZhkAJa1n0h14raNtohNyTjs-MSFx6uczVnS-OBAIWPg%3D%3D)
I always knew I wanted to serve our country. After high school, I attended West Point. After graduating with a degree in Nuclear Engineering, I was commissioned into the Infantry, completed Ranger School, and was sent to Fort Wainwright, Alaska, for my first assignment as Infantry Platoon Leader.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=6ea57a1b45be4e3a9ac9b51d2a17c44e&_e=KjZy5NawIIdKzALmDszuo7wbLW9UAkluAKS9WJ-QGaqUfIqlmS6_rv_SmgqugYlsxZUH7UqYhD26CDnqKx1gFluX4VVfi4_MlA6hzBYSL_c7h_eUuYVH8VET64PumkeCZKvlJSAiXGGCd2kR1uwIVVnF-yYFOnHUE4JxM9Nr_L7gLc9e2j3IGv4yGBw8S52AQO4mSphRH_Q0rymTYlI_6e2hM3k5_4P4zfWHh48SZGGgjf3pq-Aol1DUKIZlJVa0Klc8qRnAODbFEuabmPklSK_nBFflvMRRuF0QbmmH4VzYHD9v0_kuBqeXTx1d90rwGePh-9jfASnu2ogKQmzynA%3D%3D)
I later deployed to Afghanistan and took over a small air-access only combat outpost in the heart of the Arghandab valley. At 23 years old and in charge of roughly 350 Americans, Afghans, and expatriates, and responsible for nearly $100 million worth of infrastructure and equipment, it was a unique and formative leadership experience that shaped me for the rest of my life and led me to where I am today.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=6ea57a1b45be4e3a9ac9b51d2a17c44e&_e=KjZy5NawIIdKzALmDszuo7wbLW9UAkluAKS9WJ-QGaqUfIqlmS6_rv_SmgqugYlsxZUH7UqYhD26CDnqKx1gFluX4VVfi4_MlA6hzBYSL_c7h_eUuYVH8VET64PumkeCZKvlJSAiXGGCd2kR1uwIVVnF-yYFOnHUE4JxM9Nr_L7gLc9e2j3IGv4yGBw8S52Atp2yu98q2KSSn0ojDXBM6w-qxL2lMME1iWiggX5YqRC4bOT0X2JsDcxUA6J8L1_ehIlq04GTf0-VmOOutuMAZGN3bE1gvC3drWOClPSa6Zfxiv6qVuacvE3nvKHHi6yrsJcrO6isa44qv-KVff5R5Q%3D%3D)
My men and I enjoyed extraordinary success and upon returning to the United States, I volunteered and was selected for the Special Forces, and moved to North Carolina to complete Special Forces training.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=6ea57a1b45be4e3a9ac9b51d2a17c44e&_e=KjZy5NawIIdKzALmDszuo7wbLW9UAkluAKS9WJ-QGaqUfIqlmS6_rv_SmgqugYlsxZUH7UqYhD26CDnqKx1gFluX4VVfi4_MlA6hzBYSL_c7h_eUuYVH8VET64PumkeCZKvlJSAiXGGCd2kR1uwIVVnF-yYFOnHUE4JxM9Nr_L7gLc9e2j3IGv4yGBw8S52AEzpkPiewJJKUnZLB20_S1NEnkjZYj-Z0dgGf2f9-msJocKw65w61k8DuA0NeQ0qMZnv_Q-yVUBKo9_1FEFhOFRdGH51F3Sil1y7tDq22Rryz5gebW9LHFlueoe5JZiigwT3zhcz09087WysprnPLEQ%3D%3D)
After becoming a Green Beret, I returned to Afghanistan and led my Special Forces unit through increasingly difficult and challenging circumstances that corresponded with a deteriorating situation in Afghanistan. At this time, it became clear to me that the United States had lost the political will to win, and we had a true crisis of leadership brewing in our country.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=6ea57a1b45be4e3a9ac9b51d2a17c44e&_e=KjZy5NawIIdKzALmDszuo7wbLW9UAkluAKS9WJ-QGaqUfIqlmS6_rv_SmgqugYlsxZUH7UqYhD26CDnqKx1gFluX4VVfi4_MlA6hzBYSL_c7h_eUuYVH8VET64PumkeCZKvlJSAiXGGCd2kR1uwIVVnF-yYFOnHUE4JxM9Nr_L7gLc9e2j3IGv4yGBw8S52ATSzP97RXT4e_A8q4RwyCuF-TW1RXQSX3dzH44SW1-NGAAkb_aymou7ARBklzkKaFFcgSjtpEZWT0uLPM-hYRZ_IeUGM0SDi4iAY8p__b73U-S3nhX5eFfXTFKBcHWOG4BNsZVlViYvT81C_xFPDSsw%3D%3D)
While on active duty, my wife Rocky and I built a small firearms business that operated from our double-wide trailer home outside of Fayetteville. It grew out of our living room, then our garage, and then out of our warehouse that we built behind the double-wide.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=6ea57a1b45be4e3a9ac9b51d2a17c44e&_e=KjZy5NawIIdKzALmDszuo7wbLW9UAkluAKS9WJ-QGaqUfIqlmS6_rv_SmgqugYlsxZUH7UqYhD26CDnqKx1gFluX4VVfi4_MlA6hzBYSL_c7h_eUuYVH8VET64PumkeCZKvlJSAiXGGCd2kR1uwIVVnF-yYFOnHUE4JxM9Nr_L7gLc9e2j3IGv4yGBw8S52Avzko23FJl19Bj3vON4m9sKk4FYolIwAYMPZDgo_br5I0gI3O9jCPmoLaxZAZoCOFLTz0J0ZQ_ozl9KTXWtV3Pzx_il4YXH985K7Q00FJZJe2WKWOjlCN7RYzr4Wqyz1Xqoek99itMv23H0vjhcirRA%3D%3D)
When I left the Army, we had created a contract-manufacturing powerhouse, which we later grew into a manufacturing powerhouse. We purchased a 120,000 square foot state-of-the-art manufacturing facility and have been manufacturing American made defense products in Western North Carolina ever since.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=6ea57a1b45be4e3a9ac9b51d2a17c44e&_e=KjZy5NawIIdKzALmDszuo7wbLW9UAkluAKS9WJ-QGaqUfIqlmS6_rv_SmgqugYlsxZUH7UqYhD26CDnqKx1gFluX4VVfi4_MlA6hzBYSL_c7h_eUuYVH8VET64PumkeCZKvlJSAiXGGCd2kR1uwIVVnF-yYFOnHUE4JxM9Nr_L7gLc9e2j3IGv4yGBw8S52A9WfWktc0sKm_ofp42eddDJy-MopDZ8XwzbkDvldJMrs56dWY8IHNmaS5Wy8eZ_lRS1lUZNcInh8UKmiu372Qsy9khvj4_AYgP8b4OIELInyFp47m6s8YdqCwgryB7oUJMiDPsNAjQNu8jMlDN380DA%3D%3D)
My amazing wife Rocky and I have been married for 13 years and have 2 beautiful daughters, Reagan (6) and McKinley (4). After the fall of Afghanistan, I couldn’t stand by and watch our country deteriorate economically, socially, morally, and spiritually at the hands of failed leadership achieving failed outcomes. THAT’S why I’m running to be your next Congressman in NC-10.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=6ea57a1b45be4e3a9ac9b51d2a17c44e&_e=KjZy5NawIIdKzALmDszuo7wbLW9UAkluAKS9WJ-QGaqUfIqlmS6_rv_SmgqugYlsxZUH7UqYhD26CDnqKx1gFluX4VVfi4_MlA6hzBYSL_c7h_eUuYVH8VET64PumkeCZKvlJSAiXGGCd2kR1uwIVVnF-yYFOnHUE4JxM9Nr_L7gLc9e2j3IGv4yGBw8S52A-OmEKUfrQv62HPjxY-rcNul7E1aphFdb09wZvavuChXZ1SB8bAgwov0TJiZFZc_p8i1cEMyYS5omfeFYl8alqVbC-K_APcpSObc-M2WMWlwmMvFZpYKvQfJ2u7MBTUL_wcGR5Yno5jxT-Bt2-YdHHw%3D%3D)
Patriot, I’d NEVER ask you to support me without telling you about who I am. There are too many politicians in Washington who don’t value freedom, faith, or family, and as someone who dedicated his life to serving this country, raising a family, and running a Made In America small business, I want to serve YOU in Washington D.C.
