clean_body: | Patriot, I want to introduce myself. My name is Pat Harrigan, and I’m a Trump-Endorsed Green Beret running for Congress in North Carolina’s 10th district. I was born on the west coast and while growing up, split my time between San Diego and small-town Wyoming. I always knew I wanted to serve our country. After high school, I attended West Point. After graduating with a degree in Nuclear Engineering, I was commissioned into the Infantry, completed Ranger School, and was sent to Fort Wainwright, Alaska, for my first assignment as Infantry Platoon Leader. I later deployed to Afghanistan and took over a small air-access only combat outpost in the heart of the Arghandab valley. At 23 years old and in charge of roughly 350 Americans, Afghans, and expatriates, and responsible for nearly $100 million worth of infrastructure and equipment, it was a unique and formative leadership experience that shaped me for the rest of my life and led me to where I am today. My men and I enjoyed extraordinary success and upon returning to the United States, I volunteered and was selected for the Special Forces, and moved to North Carolina to complete Special Forces training. After becoming a Green Beret, I returned to Afghanistan and led my Special Forces unit through increasingly difficult and challenging circumstances that corresponded with a deteriorating situation in Afghanistan. At this time, it became clear to me that the United States had lost the political will to win, and we had a true crisis of leadership brewing in our country. While on active duty, my wife Rocky and I built a small firearms business that operated from our double-wide trailer home outside of Fayetteville. It grew out of our living room, then our garage, and then out of our warehouse that we built behind the double-wide. When I left the Army, we had created a contract-manufacturing powerhouse, which we later grew into a manufacturing powerhouse. We purchased a 120,000 square foot state-of-the-art manufacturing facility and have been manufacturing American made defense products in Western North Carolina ever since. My amazing wife Rocky and I have been married for 13 years and have 2 beautiful daughters, Reagan (6) and McKinley (4). After the fall of Afghanistan, I couldn’t stand by and watch our country deteriorate economically, socially, morally, and spiritually at the hands of failed leadership achieving failed outcomes. THAT’S why I’m running to be your next Congressman in NC-10. Patriot, I’d NEVER ask you to support me without telling you about who I am. There are too many politicians in Washington who don’t value freedom, faith, or family, and as someone who dedicated his life to serving this country, raising a family, and running a Made In America small business, I want to serve YOU in Washington D.C. We have less than two months until election day, and I need all the help I can get to compete with the deep-pocketed liberals running Washington. Thank you, Pat Harrigan | Paid for by The Pat Harrigan Committee PO Box 97275, Raleigh, NC 27624 Copyright (C) 2024 Pat Harrigan for Congress, All rights reserved.

body:
I have a detailed step-by-step plan (read below) to defend liberty and return to our constitutional roots.

*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* |

| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqpue5rikuqbqio02q3od70fgtrjdhfs3p6ijch8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli68ob4c1h2bs)
Friend,

All around us, big government is encroaching on our rights. Government thugs continually look for ways to encroach on our individual liberties.

You only need to look at the COVID “emergency” to see how eager the federal government is to strip away our freedom of speech. Even years after the lockdowns are over, they are still working with Big Tech companies to violate our freedom.

Our liberty is at stake.
Our prosperity is at stake.
Our very lives are at stake due to the alarming growth of the government.

_If only there were a document that set limits on the power of the federal government —**oh wait, there is!**_

**_The Constitution._**
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7ojgcs7mh6gacfmm2qlmir8ll8paunl32b53ts0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli68ob4c1h2bs)
[I have a detailed step-by-step plan (read below) to defend liberty and return to our constitutional roots. But to continue our work, I need your immediate support. I believe in our constitutional rights so much that I’m giving away pocket Constitutions to anyone who donates $10 or more. Join us now and help make liberty win!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1l2bujbrb0kjv4qc1rk2unu8d0rscv7mtvhui08_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli68ob4c1h2bs)
[Donate Now](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsqr63v4ekirbb8pn3gt6lont1kr8i1u1kq9ch38_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli68ob4c1h2bs)
You’ll often see Young Americans for Liberty (YAL) student activists handing out pocket Constitutions on their college campuses as a way to engage with other students and reintroduce them to the ideas this country was founded upon: the ideas of liberty.

We’ve even had a few student activists arrested for handing these out to their peers. _**Can you imagine getting arrested for passing out copies of the Constitution?!**_

It’s insane, but this is what we’re up against.

And while it seems like reversing these alarming trends is an impossible task, I believe we can return to those Constitutional roots that make this country great.

How?

**Using four simple steps:**
Identify.
Educate.
Train.
_Mobilize_.

**1) Identify**

Achieving our mission begins by building the youth army for liberty, and that starts with identifying youth leaders through YAL’s National Campus Program. By organizing YAL chapters on campus, we can identify bright and passionate youth activists who are open to the ideas of liberty.

**2) Educate**

Through on-campus activism, we help these chapters grow and educate their members in the philosophy of liberty. YAL provides educational resources to students on campus and organizes major events where members can learn from experts on pro-liberty philosophy.

**3) Train**

At YAL’s major training events, our expert grassroots organizers teach students essential skills to advance the ideas of liberty, empowering them to inspire real-world change.

_**4) Mobilize**_

All of this preparation is meaningless unless this army of activists actually DOES something. Knowledge is meaningless without action! Through Operation Win at the Door, YAL identifies top student activists to knock on doors to help pro-liberty candidates win and get pro-liberty legislation passed. Teams of youth activists flood key districts and make three door-knocking passes to tip the scales in favor of liberty.

Since 2018, YAL-trained youth activists have knocked over 3 million doors, with our Hazlitt Coalition members numbering over 300 liberty legislators nationwide.

**...And if you’re wondering, yes, these activists also get pocket Constitutions.**

Some use them as a guide to help them make the right decisions, and others use their pocket Constitutions as a reminder to their colleagues about the values they are sworn to uphold.

[You can click here and get your own pocket Constitution by donating $10 or more today. >>>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn2ob3064jho26eq1cn583i8ka8mb4bmc3cnest0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli68ob4c1h2bs)

Just because these steps are simple, that doesn’t mean they’re easy. It has taken years of planning and countless hours to reach this point. And we’re just getting started-

Which is why I’m asking for your urgent support.

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE
body:
There’s plenty of undecided voters, and I need help reaching them |
---

Fellow American,

I’m going to get straight to the point. A recent poll came out showing that I’m down 6 points to Amy Klobuchar in my race for Minnesota’s next United States Senator.

**I’m officially in a toss-up race.[Can you chip in a quick donation to help me catch up?](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=da0395be2b634e2ba680b7d932799261&_e=VOjB1fI2JQJOQ89PgIldb2jpkJ8utPrP1mRKXcb5V-19eYSPm3Bu5ZD3qUJ6IrXPifVDECntR6AtVsLmFmEFh1IRjow30Hdu_9Qrg1VxkoYpJhnTmeL7JrTF7zWCRHtRB4VwNNBS1G5XXKfjMiQN1KYslJDISBn5oaFLxe686lgAiKlmhrgNp8T69I55OKaFAZzD2AVvA_Q1O95un7dKDYimIo2JxljHdv240UHSS-bwRB3u0Kn6kiF5wHOVXeEtiCOA9_6oTvn_m_lph1SjABDAPAZLK3FT7ItR3YTEFoukW-x5za0ZvW-j-CXzzBndLzhZVtHC6oVO_FS1WMJcIQ%3D%3D)**

But, there’s a silver lining. 16% of voters are still undecided, and I need to do everything in my power to reach them and convince them to join our America-First Movement.

**The Industrial Media Complex is working with the Klobuchar campaign to suppress my message and amplify hers. To top it off, she’s outraising and outspending me.**

That means she’s able to place more TV ad buys and knock on more doors than I can. When it comes to reaching undecided voters, that’s terrible news for my campaign.

When I started this campaign, no one thought I would have a chance. Republicans haven’t been able to unseat Klobuchar since she was elected on the back of Barack Obama’s 2008 victory.

But I’m different from the Republicans who ran before me. I’m running a completely grassroots-driven campaign, free from the shackles of prior political corruption.

**I speak my voice, and I don’t answer to anyone but my supporters. The American people.**

As a black athlete, most of the Industrial Media Complex and Democrats think I’m supposed to vote blue and accept the affirmative action policies of the Radical Left.

name: Jeff Frazee - YAL
subject: A (pocket) protector of freedom
body:
I have a detailed step-by-step plan (read below) to defend liberty and return to our constitutional roots.

*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* |
---
| | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbskbs9fgn0bdcd6da9d9bkbbrpvmdb3ebmon3ao_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli64pj4cph2bs)
Friend,

All around us, big government is encroaching on our rights. Government thugs continually look for ways to encroach on our individual liberties.

You only need to look at the COVID “emergency” to see how eager the federal government is to strip away our freedom of speech. Even years after the lockdowns are over, they are still working with Big Tech companies to violate our freedom.

Our liberty is at stake.
Our prosperity is at stake.
Our very lives are at stake due to the alarming growth of the government.

_If only there were a document that set limits on the power of the federal government —**oh wait, there is!**_

**_The Constitution._**
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zr42qj2q8e2lsme6u19regmvds3nq414ubmtc950_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli64pj4cph2bs)
[I have a detailed step-by-step plan (read below) to defend liberty and return to our constitutional roots. But to continue our work, I need your immediate support. I believe in our constitutional rights so much that I’m giving away pocket Constitutions to anyone who donates $10 or more. Join us now and help make liberty win!](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdudhhtlo3a4vvpgcded0g580ogrbpfpoltm77b8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli64pj4cph2bs)
[Donate Now](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zkhffh3hndrm7qhlb5b1vc22e9v0c3vldjgg04bo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli64pj4cph2bs)
You’ll often see Young Americans for Liberty (YAL) student activists handing out pocket Constitutions on their college campuses as a way to engage with other students and reintroduce them to the ideas this country was founded upon: the ideas of liberty.

We’ve even had a few student activists arrested for handing these out to their peers. _**Can you imagine getting arrested for passing out copies of the Constitution?!**_

It’s insane, but this is what we’re up against.

And while it seems like reversing these alarming trends is an impossible task, I believe we can return to those Constitutional roots that make this country great.

How?

**Using four simple steps:**
Identify.
Educate.
Train.
_Mobilize_.

**1) Identify**

Achieving our mission begins by building the youth army for liberty, and that starts with identifying youth leaders through YAL’s National Campus Program. By organizing YAL chapters on campus, we can identify bright and passionate youth activists who are open to the ideas of liberty.

**2) Educate**

Through on-campus activism, we help these chapters grow and educate their members in the philosophy of liberty. YAL provides educational resources to students on campus and organizes major events where members can learn from experts on pro-liberty philosophy.

**3) Train**

At YAL’s major training events, our expert grassroots organizers teach students essential skills to advance the ideas of liberty, empowering them to inspire real-world change.

_**4) Mobilize**_

All of this preparation is meaningless unless this army of activists actually DOES something. Knowledge is meaningless without action! Through Operation Win at the Door, YAL identifies top student activists to knock on doors to help pro-liberty candidates win and get pro-liberty legislation passed. Teams of youth activists flood key districts and make three door-knocking passes to tip the scales in favor of liberty.

Since 2018, YAL-trained youth activists have knocked over 3 million doors, with our Hazlitt Coalition members numbering over 300 liberty legislators nationwide.

**...And if you’re wondering, yes, these activists also get pocket Constitutions.**

Some use them as a guide to help them make the right decisions, and others use their pocket Constitutions as a reminder to their colleagues about the values they are sworn to uphold.

[You can click here and get your own pocket Constitution by donating $10 or more today. >>>](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zqq7uqb19r94vm4cojkikohm33f638ag7pvum8g0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli64pj4cph2bs)

Just because these steps are simple, that doesn’t mean they’re easy. It has taken years of planning and countless hours to reach this point. And we’re just getting started-

Which is why I’m asking for your urgent support.

**I’m giving away pocket Constitutions to anyone who donates $10 or more to Young Americans for Liberty because this document means that much to me - and means that much to our country. Please click below to get yours today.**
[**Donate $10**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zffc9p6gaciftjsh90uos3j01ke5brlgch7cav2o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli64pj4cph2bs)

# 49 days remaining!
---
|
With just 49 days remaining until Election Day, the momentum is building, and I couldn’t be more excited about the progress we've made together. Our campaign is about delivering real solutions—grounded in data, driven by compassion, and focused on the needs of our community. But there’s still work to be done.

We are up against opponents with deep pockets, and while they may rely on big donors, we are fueled by supporters like you. Every dollar raised brings us one step closer to amplifying the voices of those who are often ignored or marginalized. Together, we can create a future where everyone has a seat at the table, especially those who have historically been left behind.With your help, we will:
* Fight for better access to healthcare, especially for women and people of color who have been dismissed or neglected in our medical system.

* Champion education that breaks down barriers and empowers students from all backgrounds to succeed in STEM and beyond.

* Work towards a safer, more just society where communities thrive, and no one has to live in fear of violence.

To win, we need to make sure our message reaches every corner of the district. Whether it's knocking on doors, making calls, or spreading our message through digital ads, your contribution will make a difference.Will you chip in $10, $25, or even $50 today? Your support is critical as we enter the final stretch.Together, we will create a brighter future—one where every voice matters.Thank you for standing with us.

In solidarity,River Gassen
Candidate for U.S. Congress - Colorado District 5

subject: A (pocket) protector of freedom
body:
I have a detailed step-by-step plan (read below) to defend liberty and return to our constitutional roots.

*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* |
---
| | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zibnlus5nct755oihns174oeq8aju77jls4o8ag8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli6coj4clh2bs)
Friend,

All around us, big government is encroaching on our rights. Government thugs continually look for ways to encroach on our individual liberties.

You only need to look at the COVID “emergency” to see how eager the federal government is to strip away our freedom of speech. Even years after the lockdowns are over, they are still working with Big Tech companies to violate our freedom.

Our liberty is at stake.
Our prosperity is at stake.
Our very lives are at stake due to the alarming growth of the government.

_If only there were a document that set limits on the power of the federal government —**oh wait, there is!**_

**_The Constitution._**
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zc4mmaesu5e2ci2ijfbdg1ufg6mavbo1dbjso09g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli6coj4clh2bs)
[I have a detailed step-by-step plan (read below) to defend liberty and return to our constitutional roots. But to continue our work, I need your immediate support. I believe in our constitutional rights so much that I’m giving away pocket Constitutions to anyone who donates $10 or more. Join us now and help make liberty win!](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgsvel6dc2srnvlbsbq77i4hvvg86sakn1ptrn40_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli6coj4clh2bs)
[Donate Now](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zk82dfl3cs56cjkn1j3irkhkq6444hmt3kaob48o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli6coj4clh2bs)
You’ll often see Young Americans for Liberty (YAL) student activists handing out pocket Constitutions on their college campuses as a way to engage with other students and reintroduce them to the ideas this country was founded upon: the ideas of liberty.

We’ve even had a few student activists arrested for handing these out to their peers. _**Can you imagine getting arrested for passing out copies of the Constitution?!**_

It’s insane, but this is what we’re up against.

And while it seems like reversing these alarming trends is an impossible task, I believe we can return to those Constitutional roots that make this country great.

How?

**Using four simple steps:**
Identify.
Educate.
Train.
_Mobilize_.

**1) Identify**

Achieving our mission begins by building the youth army for liberty, and that starts with identifying youth leaders through YAL’s National Campus Program. By organizing YAL chapters on campus, we can identify bright and passionate youth activists who are open to the ideas of liberty.

**2) Educate**

Through on-campus activism, we help these chapters grow and educate their members in the philosophy of liberty. YAL provides educational resources to students on campus and organizes major events where members can learn from experts on pro-liberty philosophy.

**3) Train**

At YAL’s major training events, our expert grassroots organizers teach students essential skills to advance the ideas of liberty, empowering them to inspire real-world change.

_**4) Mobilize**_

All of this preparation is meaningless unless this army of activists actually DOES something. Knowledge is meaningless without action! Through Operation Win at the Door, YAL identifies top student activists to knock on doors to help pro-liberty candidates win and get pro-liberty legislation passed. Teams of youth activists flood key districts and make three door-knocking passes to tip the scales in favor of liberty.

Since 2018, YAL-trained youth activists have knocked over 3 million doors, with our Hazlitt Coalition members numbering over 300 liberty legislators nationwide.

**...And if you’re wondering, yes, these activists also get pocket Constitutions.**

Some use them as a guide to help them make the right decisions, and others use their pocket Constitutions as a reminder to their colleagues about the values they are sworn to uphold.

[You can click here and get your own pocket Constitution by donating $10 or more today. >>>](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zk9ivho12hhfincdqaqitq5rmgept78smq5cqdsg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cli6coj4clh2bs)

Just because these steps are simple, that doesn’t mean they’re easy. It has taken years of planning and countless hours to reach this point. And we’re just getting started-

Which is why I’m asking for your urgent support.

Government thugs continually look for ways to encroach on our individual liberties. You only need to look at the COVID “emergency” to see how eager the federal government is to strip away our freedom of speech. Even years after the lockdowns are over, they are still working with Big Tech companies to violate our freedom. Our liberty is at stake. Our prosperity is at stake. Our very lives are at stake due to the alarming growth of the government. If only there were a document that set limits on the power of the federal government —oh wait, there is! The Constitution. You’ll often see Young Americans for Liberty (YAL) student activists handing out pocket Constitutions on their college campuses as a way to engage with other students and reintroduce them to the ideas this country was founded upon: the ideas of liberty. We’ve even had a few student activists arrested for handing these out to their peers. Can you imagine getting arrested for passing out copies of the Constitution?! It’s insane, but this is what we’re up against. And while it seems like reversing these alarming trends is an impossible task, I believe we can return to those Constitutional roots that make this country great. How? Using four simple steps: Identify. Educate. Train. Mobilize. 1) Identify Achieving our mission begins by building the youth army for liberty, and that starts with identifying youth leaders through YAL’s National Campus Program. By organizing YAL chapters on campus, we can identify bright and passionate youth activists who are open to the ideas of liberty. 2) Educate Through on-campus activism, we help these chapters grow and educate their members in the philosophy of liberty. YAL provides educational resources to students on campus and organizes major events where members can learn from experts on pro-liberty philosophy. 3) Train At YAL’s major training events, our expert grassroots organizers teach students essential skills to advance the ideas of liberty, empowering them to inspire real-world change. 4) Mobilize All of this preparation is meaningless unless this army of activists actually DOES something. Through Operation Win at the Door, YAL identifies top student activists to knock on doors to help pro-liberty candidates win and get pro-liberty legislation passed. Teams of youth activists flood key districts and make three door-knocking passes to tip the scales in favor of liberty. Since 2018, YAL-trained youth activists have knocked over 3 million doors, with our Hazlitt Coalition members numbering over 300 liberty legislators nationwide. ...And if you’re wondering, yes, these activists also get pocket Constitutions. Some use them as a guide to help them make the right decisions, and others use their pocket Constitutions as a reminder to their colleagues about the values they are sworn to uphold. Just because these steps are simple, that doesn’t mean they’re easy. It has taken years of planning and countless hours to reach this point. Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom's commitment to the people of New Jersey has been inspired by a legacy of **dedicated public service** from his grandfather, former U.S. Representative Robert Kean, to his father, former Governor Thomas H. Kean Sr. Kean has always understood and recognized the importance of civic engagement and is honored to **represent the people of New Jersey's 7th Congressional District** in Congress. From his early days in the Environmental Protection Agency during the George H.W. Bush Administration (where he met his incredible wife Rhonda), to serving as a volunteer firefighter and an emergency medical technician in Washington, D.C. — Tom has always had a heart for making our world a better, freer, safer place. Determined to answer the call to public service again, Tom Kean Jr. believed he, personally, could turn ideas into action and make a lasting difference in people’s lives. In 2001, Tom was elected to the New Jersey General Assembly, and two years later, was named to the upper house of the state legislature after his tireless work in ethics reform. Then in 2008, his peers unanimously elected him Republican Leader in the New Jersey Senate. Shortly thereafter, he unveiled his caucus’ job creation package, **“Common-Sense Plan for a More Affordable New Jersey,”** which ultimately reversed the course that previous administrations were quickly leading the state down. To this day, Tom continues to build upon his proven track record of delivering for the people of New Jersey in Congress:
* **Passed legislation that provides firefighters and their communities the protection they need**
* **Passed legislation advocating for Veteran-Owned small businesses**
* **Passed legislation to improve commuter rail transportation**
* **Passed a resolution affirming strong US support for Ukraine**
* **Passed legislation to support mental health for school children**

Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=091624_1&amount=25]
Folks, The truth is clear:
We need to act to save the United States Postal Service from Wall Street and Trump-appointed Postmaster General Louis DeJoy.
It’s no accident that DeJoy -- the first Postmaster General in two decades without experience working in the postal service -- was appointed just months after Trumps’ Office of Management and Budget released recommendations that the USPS should be privatized. The result has been the slow decimation of one of America’s most treasured institutions.
Mail slowdowns and historic price hikes have made DeJoy’s claim that the USPS is in a “death spiral” a self fulfilling prophecy . More mail slowdowns would hurt rural communities the most because -- unlike UPS and FedEx -- the USPS is required by law to deliver all mail to all regions timely, and at a flat rate.
This year, our movement, working with Congress, forced DeJoy to pause closures of USPS processing centers until at least January 2025, to help protect vote-by-mail in this crucial election year .
Now it’s time to do it again -- This time to stop the new mail slowdowns set to hit rural communities the hardest, and demand service delivery be restored to 2012 standards to completely erase the damage done by Louis DeJoy.
Sign our petition now: Don’t let Louis DeJoy privatize the USPS! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/dont-let-dejoy-privatize-the-usps/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/dont-let-dejoy-privatize-the-usps/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
DeJoy sees mail service drop off as “inevitable” and says his price hikes aren’t speeding up the decline. He’s wrong. The combination of higher prices and slower delivery virtually guarantees the USPS will lose more customers. Since slowdowns started a little over a decade ago, and accelerated under DeJoy, first-class mail volume has shrunk by 28%.
His decisions affect us all, but folks in rural areas, including many Indigenous communities, seniors, and veterans are the ones who will pay the greatest price, because for many -- the post office is their lifeline . These communities rely on the postal service to receive medications and to vote-by-mail, because some towns are too small for polling places and don’t have a pharmacy.
When DeJoy has faced pressure from Congress and everyday people like you and me, we’ve won . On electric vehicles, he agreed to make a minimum of 62% of new USPS vehicle purchases electric, up from his initial plan of just 10%. We didn’t stop the pressure and he then also committed to a 40% reduction in overall USPS emissions by 2030. We all must step up one more time.
Send a message directly to your members of Congress and the USPS Board of Governors demanding they stop mail slowdowns and price hikes, and restore 2012 delivery standards, to save the post office now >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/dont-let-dejoy-privatize-the-usps/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

September 16, 2024
During the recent presidential debate, former President Trump stated that [Haitians who immigrated](https://substack.com/redirect/d3d670be-2ce6-46b5-bc6a-c9f8fd16ea82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Springfield, Ohio were eating other people's pets. Thus far, to my knowledge, there has been no objective evidence that this is true.

But it has created the usual political mess with wealthy white liberals screeching racism even though these same liberals would scream bloody murder if Haitians were housed in their communities.
Liberal hypocrisy is galling.
As a young doctor forty years ago, I spent a volunteer year in Haiti working with the Missionaries of Charity, the Order of Mother Teresa. I saw one hundred patients a day. I saw hideous disfiguring illnesses and constant death, especially among children and babies. AIDS was common, courtesy of gay American sex tourists seeking what tourist magazines called "Nubian delights."
These noble people have been shafted. Haiti is the only successful slave revolt in history. But this source of pride among the Haitians is also a curse because unlike other Caribbean islands that tolerated colonialism, Haiti never developed democratic institutions that would have allowed it to thrive, such as in the Bahamas, Bermuda and Barbados.
The Republic of Haiti was formed in 1804 but was not recognized by the United States until 1863. Why? Because American politicians feared Haiti's successful slave revolt would spread to the United States.
When I lived in Haiti, the country was a dictatorship run by the Duvalier family and their cronies. Once I spoke to a Baptist minister who had dedicated his life to Haiti. I told him that for there to be progress, the Duvalier dictatorship had to go. He responded: And replace it with what?
He was correct. When this dictatorship was overthrown, Haiti continued to have increasingly unstable governments and now is run by brutal warlords.
Thus, Haitians are willing to do anything to get out of the country. If I were Haitian, I would do the same thing.
So how did we arrive with this political mess in Springfield, Ohio?
This town is a perfect example of why Trump won in 2016. Its manufacturing jobs were shipped overseas, and unemployment, poverty and drug abuse became rampant.

The Biden administration authorized a policy that allows 30,000 immigrants to enter to the United States monthly from the dysfunctional and Communist countries of Cuba, Haiti, Nicaragua and Venezuela.
And these are legal immigrants. They apply online in their native country, are approved by our government and must pay their own way to fly to the United States. Once here, they are steered toward poor and working-class communities. And then the problems start.
Many receive immediate assistance - food, free health care, housing vouchers etc. - while many natives in the communities are struggling. Haitians do not speak English (although many pick it up in six months) and quickly overwhelm the local school systems. Property taxes must be raised to fund this.
Haitians are also hard workers. The average Haitian family who lives in the United States for five years has more money in the bank than the average white family.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7802a6f9-7840-4881-94d7-6366a70fb924?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A small business in Springfield, Ohio owned by Haitian immigrants
Mr. Jaime McGregor is the owner of the manufacturing factory McGregor Metals in Springfield. He employs thirty Haitians. [He stated:](https://substack.com/redirect/ad8b302d-df4d-4448-bdb7-f68a14391260?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"I wish I had 30 more. Our Haitian associates come to work every day. They don't have a drug problem. They'll stay at their machine. They'll achieve their numbers. They are here to work. And so in general, that's a stark difference from what we're used to in our community."
Thus, cultural clashes are inevitable.
Trump's demagoguery is wrong, but the white liberals castigating him are even worse. At least most of most of the people in Springfield are trying to get along with the Haitians.
What would happen if 20,000 Haitian arrived in Westport, Connecticut asking for housing, medical care, food and education? This town voted for Biden 75 to 25%. And the town is 1.04% Black. The only Haitians seen in Westport are wearing leaf blowers.
Here's what would happen. These rich white Westport liberals would call another rich white liberal, Ned Lamont. He would immediately call the National Guard and have the Haitians forcibly removed.
If you don't believe, look what happened when Governor DeSantis of Florida sent some illegal immigrants to Martha's Vineyard - a town that voted for Biden by 84% to 16%. The liberal white liberal Governor of Massachusetts Maura Healey sent in the armed National Guard and had them [forcibly removed.](https://substack.com/redirect/db1d28f2-97c4-455e-abba-d7e9ed9e81d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Until Haitian immigrants are learning algebra in the Westport school system or reading Chaucer at Darien High School, white liberals have no right to pose as morally superior to poor struggling rural whites whose jobs have been sent overseas because of corporate greed. Especially since these wealthy white liberal towns manipulate zoning laws and use environment mandates to prevent affordable housing development so that they can keep Haitians and Blacks in general, out of their towns.

## Disaster Briefs
**Disaster Briefs** are your semi-regular summaries and headlines from around the world about natural and man-made disasters, climate change, disease and health, and international conflict. See endnotes for resources used in putting this report together. Data is retrieved, analyzed and summarized on the day of publication unless otherwise noted.
#### _**Updates:**_
Complimentary subscriptions from August will be expiring this week. Please see the bottom of this post for more information on how to continue your access.
* * *
## **Meteorological/Climatological**
**Hurricane Francine** made landfall south of Morgan City, Louisiana on Sept. 11 of last week as a Category 2 hurricane with maximum sustained winds of 100 mph and a minimum central pressure of 972 mbar. Areas of the Southeast received as much as 12.75" of rain as the storm continued northward. Much of the area impacted in Louisiana was devastated by Hurricane Ida in 2021 - the second-strongest hurricane to ever hit Louisiana. Francine hit the historical lands of the Chitimacha tribe - the first federally-recognized Native American tribe in Louisiana.
| [](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F01e14e36-24ac-4e89-a2e5-6cef2accee8c_484x500.jpeg)|
---|---|---
As of Sept. 16, 2024, there are two tropical cyclones active in the Atlantic basin.
**Gordon** is expected to hook northward in the open Atlantic before dissipating.
Potential tropical cyclone eight (likely to be named **Ernesto** later today) is expected to reach tropical storm strength and make landfall near Wilmington, North Carolina tomorrow.
Wildfires in California burned nearly 11,000 hectares of land near Trabuco Canyon over the weekend, with severe fires also reported in the San Bernandino and Angeles National Forests.
* * *
## **Geologic**
The Global Volcanism Program at the Smithsonian Institution issued six new reports for new activity/unrest last week:
* Kanlaon (Philippines)
* Kikai (Japan)
* Klyuchevskoy and Karymsky(Russia)
* Reykjanes (Iceland)
* Whakaari (New Zealand)

In the last seven days, 193 total seismic shaking events were reported by the USGS, with 97 of those registering as a magnitude 4.5 or greater, and three considered significant shaking (one each in Canada, Northern Mariana Islands and Papua New Guinea).
* * *
## **Public Health**
**Cholera**
The World Health Organization reported that Haiti's Cholera situation worsened dramatically in 2023, resulting in more than 44,000 deaths last year. Globally, cholera cases[ jumped 71%](https://substack.com/redirect/2ecf6b77-1d93-493b-8ce4-1713ae227018?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over the previous year.
**COVID-19**
The World Health Organization reported that 3,480 Americans died of COVID-19 in the last 28 days, making up 77% of all global deaths during the past month. Cumulatively, the United States lost 1,197,213 Americans to the disease, or 17% of all global COVID-19 deaths, despite being only 4% of the world's population.
Data from the CDC shows that Florida (22 million people) reported more COVID-19 deaths than Texas (30 million people) and more per-capita deaths than California (40 million people) during the past three months. Florida reported 720 deaths in the CDC's latest update, whereas California had 1,036 and Texas 609.
Deaths per 100k during CDC report period:
* Florida: 3.27
* California: 2.59
* Texas: 2.02

* * *
## **International Conflict**
#### **Iran**
Jailed female activists began a hunger strike from prison yesterday. The activists, including Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi, are calling for deeper political rights in the country and honoring the two-year anniversary of the "Woman, Life, Freedom" protest movement.
On September 10, the United States unveiled new sanctions on Iran's main airline and France, Germany, and the United Kingdom (UK) said they would cancel air services to and from Iran; the countries [said](https://substack.com/redirect/e7c713de-5ecc-4440-a3f7-54087fcbf616?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the actions were a response to Tehran's transfer of ballistic missiles to Moscow for use in Ukraine.
#### **Jordan**
Israeli forces began digging trenches along its border with Jordan over the weekend in an attempt to prevent resource deliveries and border crossings at the King Hussein Bridge, which connects Jordan to the illegally-occupied West Bank of Palestine. Jordan condemned Netanyahu's plans that aim to expand Israeli control over occupied Palestinian lands.
| [](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fb4d3e1be-2af8-44ff-a495-2284cb865205_770x962.png)|
---|---|---
#### **Lebanon**
Israeli attacks on Lebanon continue to claim lives in the southern city of Houla as the IOF extends its attacks farther into neighboring nations. Israel released videos of illegal air raids they conducted in the southern Lebanon city of Hula yesterday, which killed at least one person.
#### **Mali**
A[ new report](https://substack.com/redirect/18fae47e-c9f3-491f-bff1-f3fafd930d9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) found that Mali rebels killed dozens of fighters from Russia's [Wagner](https://substack.com/redirect/ccb699d2-8678-4de6-906f-d7c93d7df239?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) paramilitary group last July. Mali's defeat of such experienced fighters reveals setbacks Russia is facing in its push in Africa. African governments have increasingly welcomed economic, diplomatic, and security ties with Russia--leading Western countries to denounce what they see as Moscow's destabilizing influence and seek their own, more equal partnerships.
#### **Myanmar**
**As the civil war in Myanmar worsens, more than 8,000** Rohingya[ have fled to Bangladesh](https://substack.com/redirect/5b12c1e7-e23b-4561-b6df-7c0d76ea60c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the past few months. The Rohingya are an ethnic group of about 2 million people whose ties to Myanmar date back a millenia. The Rohingya are experiencing an ongoing genocide started in 2017 at the hands of Buddhist nationalists and the Arakan Army in Myanmar. The [UN has declared ](https://substack.com/redirect/033fd65c-3c01-4fe4-b8c8-e44c7e1a8c12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Myanmar's persecution of the majority-Muslim Rohingya an ethnic cleansing, crime against humanity, and genocide.
### **Spotlight on Palestine**
Bombings and targeted murders by Israeli forces continue as the humanitarian crisis worsens in the Palestinian territories of Gaza, the West Bank and Golan Heights.
On **Friday, Sept. 6,** the IOF shot an American citizen in the head as she was protesting illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Aysenyr Eygi, 26 and from Seattle, was protesting ongoing land theft by Israelis in Beita when a sniper shot and killed her. US Secretary of State Anthony Blinken called the murder "unprovoked and unjustified." "No-one should be shot and killed for attending a protest, no-one should have to put their life at risk just for freely expressing their views," Blinken told reporters shortly after Israel's release of the findings. Since 1967, Israel has illegally built more than 160 settlements and moved in more than 700,000 Israelis in the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem. The vast majority of the international community considers the settlements illegal under international law. The West Bank is roughly the size of Delaware and borders Jordan to the east along the Jordan River.
Israeli forces killed 19 people in an illegal strike within a designated [Gaza Humanitarian Zone](https://substack.com/redirect/b78a9da3-b2bc-4cd4-813b-5f1468e8825d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on **September 10,** despite an agreed humanitarian pause during an UNRWA Polio vaccination program.**** The UNRWA completed a successful 10- day program to[ vaccinate nearly 640,000 children ](https://substack.com/redirect/a675eb4e-41bd-40d1-96fe-1b5497379293?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)for Polio in Gaza after health workers[ identified a case there last month](https://substack.com/redirect/bd0f8ec7-be01-4719-b2b1-8bd7ae3bc443?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). During the humanitarian pause, there were no reported attacks by Hamas or other resistance groups, though the IOF did continue to bomb refugee centers. Despite Israel not adhering to the temporary ceasefire, health care workers continue to vaccinate children, meeting the minimum 90% inoculation rate needed to maintain community immunity.
**On September 11,** six UN workers were killed when the [IOF bombed a school](https://substack.com/redirect/b78a9da3-b2bc-4cd4-813b-5f1468e8825d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) where refugees were sheltering. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres condemned yesterday's strike, calling it "totally unacceptable."
On **September 15** , an Israeli human rights group found that hundreds of women from Gaza are currently being held illegally in Israeli prisons and are being subject to torture, starvation and medical crimes. "Twenty-three women are being held under administrative detention without charge or trial, while most of the rest are detained for alleged 'incitement', including students, lawyers, journalists, activists and mothers."
**So far today, September 16, 2024:**
The IOF bombed a bakery in the[ al-Mawasi refugee camp,](https://substack.com/redirect/e9de2e10-8de1-4ec6-841c-90e321dae012?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) killing at least five people, including two children.
A second bombing at the [Nusierat camp killed 10 people](https://substack.com/redirect/7cfc38c3-89d6-4926-b323-4128a13cb982?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (including four women and two children), and bombings in both Zeitoun and Sheikh Radwan killed 10 more (including women and at least two children.
Israeli settlers in Ramallah (West Bank) attacked a Palestinian school, beating staff members and tying up and torturing the principal. Hassan Malihat, a Palestinian lawyer who at the time was visiting the school near the city of Jericho, said the settlers entered at around 8 a.m. He says the Israeli army arrived about two hours later and arrested three staff members, including the principal. [Terrorism by Israeli settlers](https://substack.com/redirect/89a1dede-771f-4dcb-b872-1af380540436?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has continued to worsen over the last year, despite the West Bank's independence from both Hamas and its occupying forces.
#### **Pakistan**
The U.S. Department of State[ announced sanctions](https://substack.com/redirect/5d324280-3f5d-435a-ac82-7400d0569ebd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against China-based firms for supplying Pakistan's missile program, alleging that a research institute, several entities, and one individual based in China, as well as one entity based in Pakistan, had been involved in the provision of materials for controlled missile equipment and technology.
#### **Sudan**
The UN Security Council[ extended](https://substack.com/redirect/7428a296-53b6-42ba-8785-36e7562a7085?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) sanctions against arms flowing into western Darfur until September 2025, adding in an extension of asset freezes and travel bans. Days earlier, Sudan's foreign ministry [rejected ](https://substack.com/redirect/f1d59b18-64ba-4007-85ad-b36371a2a200?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)a UN plan to send peacekeeping forces into the country. Sudan's civil war is in its second year, with more than [15,000 killed](https://substack.com/redirect/e8a26d59-9845-49ae-8508-e93916a1a067?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [8.2 million displaced ](https://substack.com/redirect/b15f8c7f-79b5-4622-85fc-1bd06b067229?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)since April 2023.

Spain [granted asylum ](https://substack.com/redirect/653a3da4-beb2-4739-9779-b114a58e9f98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)to Edmundo Gonzalez Urrutia, a candidate in Venezuela's July election that the United States says won the most votes, but whom Venezuelan authorities[ had threatened to arrest](https://substack.com/redirect/20061375-009e-4786-8306-721f256da675?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); Gonzalez had spent weeks in hiding in what has become a fraught post-election impasse.

| Elizabeth Warren Tries to Play Both Sides: Cancels Appearance but Refuses to Condemn Antisemitic Group
---
---
|
BOSTON, MA- In May, Elizabeth Warren abruptly canceled a planned appearance at a conference organized by anti-Israel organization, 7Amleh, who praised Hamas' Oct. 7th attack that killed 1,400 and left hundreds taken hostage.
[Jewish Insider](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001leh9pqfLuagJ_YtFgtxHWYn6A4h8F44mODW4lk4CRCnVzgUKrEILlUYdfqsSQjBiQKkDKCV5t5kdb9KJusDZv7s3NGGQ_g6W3SHgIggn6j6B21imw5_IPjhs0kybsPD8ja4QJg7t3_GlzezReU345oWN-F_pBzeRcsQZTG-83vJA8h8vZHB6F1maxBjzKRjPTmUm0cdmr0h_FmwYzydFuvwtvkPct97omj3r5jwFHZoVHx4UAC9c7Zzbrg7Xglvm2iq2MuPuIEm9uJnUEAAXzPg_i8kvzKGD&c=2E7U___cEiUt5QHASMCEMNLVGPsK0r8i8aApoMRV4O7bgROwP6xWEA==&ch=Uh4DRNbrXC1pKqSx5C1PboTju7yj2LAig_JTiLJpUYvM7J0EVI6S1Q==) uncovered how the conference's host organization 7amleh counts Nevin Abu Rahmoun in its leadership. Following Hamas' attack, Rahmoun warned Jewish individuals everywhere "the message of the resistance is clear, it has started and it shall escalate and shall impose a new reality."
The organization's project coordinator, Mohammad Badarneh, wrote in a now-deleted online post that "the only important value of a human being living under occupation is the extent of his resistance to that occupation, in all possible means."
Before the 2023 attack, 7amleh's monitoring and documentation officer, Ahmad Qadi, celebrated attacks on Jewish synagogues around the globe, writing online, "every Israeli crime is met with greater determination for sacrifice, broader resistance and...victory."
Despite members of the organization's clear antisemitic statements, a Warren spokesperson said her decision to forgo an appearance had nothing to do with 7Amleh and said "we do not assume any of the claims are true."
MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale commented on Warren's preference towards political opportunism and allegiance to bad actors stating, "What is most disturbing is that, while she avoided attending the event with 7amleh, she ensured her standing with this group by refusing to condemn past antisemitic remarks from its members and effectively giving them a pass."
"Elizabeth Warren has openly accused Israel of committing 'genocide' in its efforts to eliminate the terrorists behind the deadliest attack in its history. As antisemitism grows in Massachusetts, now is not the time for equivocation. Warren must be held accountable for the antisemitic movement she has helped fuel," Carnevale concluded.

| | Dear Friends,

After more than a year of incessant campaigning and taking on the establishment during the US Senate campaign, I've taken much needed time off to spend with family since Utah's June Primary. Although I was disappointed in the end results, the campaign was an unmatched experience to meet Utahns across the state, receive donations from over 7000 individuals, earn the endorsements of so many conservative leaders across the country to include President Donald Trump, and be supported by over 130,000 Utah voters and volunteers! I want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone involved.

As our nation enters the general election season, let's discuss next steps:

Folks, we are closing in on the final sprint of this election cycle, and a Democratic majority in the House is * this close* to being a reality. But it’s not going to just happen by itself, so let’s talk about how we can get there.
Right now, the balance of the House’s 435 seats is 220 Republican-held seats to 211 Democratic-held seats. (There are four vacant seats, three of which were held by Democrats, and one by a Republican.) Basically, come November, we just need four more seats and we’ll finally have the chance to govern the way the American people actually deserve.
We can get those four seats a bunch of different ways, but one state everyone seems to agree is critical is – you guessed it – California!
Here in CA, we have seven extremely important battleground races that need your help today – one incumbent, and six challengers:

Thanks for everything you do to support Democrats!

subject: Take our Critical Race Theory Survey
body:
I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=3e55b33edfae41548db1850790e5fd39&_e=04Gi9muiMsB5OWaabsR8Q7TSsAeXAYJjoyxZyj0wGmB_BTqMqk0sdnEzHXaS_fQ_gHifD4SGqcsaRYNrzCS9v5cQebTbKCK2t92BA4K0KMX92Thlu7uPFSKjvN3Idoy0cuFdEILK024uWh9W8e6yeSNwM00-YBBYV7qqyzTgdzb6Ay0dCrxvJ8N0BhkCmvj6T4OwgArgpNFzlrdmY7P589yFisWawCLBb5sn7PCnxId051btHBTQ2hWguoj6ycFaZRZaa0Igzo1wR-kIMvv7hQOS9uK4Ml0soke9kSfixway4OoRdM3u0J36R9vh63qirluQzjkBWX9lXSm3BJu19VTdWS4mxQ8q2raVeHTfGtfyTlomeDDe3RDhKHtavU2U)

| | Dear Fellow American,

I'm glad you opened my email today! I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

[**Will you take our National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT)?**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=3e55b33edfae41548db1850790e5fd39&_e=04Gi9muiMsB5OWaabsR8Q7TSsAeXAYJjoyxZyj0wGmB_BTqMqk0sdnEzHXaS_fQ_gHifD4SGqcsaRYNrzCS9v5cQebTbKCK2t92BA4K0KMX92Thlu7uPFSKjvN3Idoy0cuFdEILK024uWh9W8e6yeSNwM00-YBBYV7qqyzTgdzb6Ay0dCrxvJ8N0BhkCmvj6T4OwgArgpNFzlrdmY7P589yFisWawCLBb5sn7PCnxIfNZqTbAG6JcIHimeTlw-nxcePMELX3GoMNyvspz5qaUiyDO6w86HiJLcDGme7ndAX5YFFHdP_6OGh6ePhxM-KYcH4vgfli5I5c6plSE9GJF32fkuCXEosRAGCtdS9Qu4ZdDq4WABHDBr4iP3ipJold)

Your participation will help us understand and address many Americans' concerns about CRT's influence on our society.

This survey will only take just a few minutes.

But in those few minutes, you'll help us gather important insights to defend America's founding principles of liberty...

...and ensure a bright future for our children and grandchildren.

**You can share your thoughts on CRT in the National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory Survey here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=3e55b33edfae41548db1850790e5fd39&_e=04Gi9muiMsB5OWaabsR8Q7TSsAeXAYJjoyxZyj0wGmB_BTqMqk0sdnEzHXaS_fQ_gHifD4SGqcsaRYNrzCS9v5cQebTbKCK2t92BA4K0KMX92Thlu7uPFSKjvN3Idoy0cuFdEILK024uWh9W8e6yeSNwM00-YBBYV7qqyzTgdzb6Ay0dCrxvJ8N0BhkCmvj6T4OwgArgpNFzlrdmY7P589yFisWawCLBb5sn7PCnxIc2wLCuIF6pW2ad8DNPrPMr1fxzzBToiy8hmRzY2mnpnaIbeUItvs-trc5yqitUfInogml3QvHYuwA1n_razEAAOJgDTQEJoipBDnVAdYGmlE8Kcm-HNMmw_2tYe9gv9GWcL9_1043dIK5oy_QCON4P)

Sharing your opinion is an important way you'll combat the spread of CRT in our schools and workplaces. Together, we can preserve the constitutional and free-enterprise principles that made our nation so great and so free.

Thanks in advance! I look forward to seeing your response.

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWd6zAiWNN

I feel like our culture has forgotten-or ignored-some
very important and basic lessons

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWd6zAiWNN

Fellow
Patriot,

I feel
like our culture has forgotten-or ignored-some very important and
basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our
society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its
most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was
once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has
become the new normal.

Medicine
tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also
tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves,
and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not
treated as though they are alive or even human.

As a
surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you
that they are very much alive.

Life is a
precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No
person is disposable, and every life is precious according to
Him.

I believe
that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this
right by our society. I believe that together we can make a
difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also
believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe
that you believe that too.

I've
started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are
looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that
values life but that takes people like you and I making a
commitment.

The first
step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing
to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me today
and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?

I've
created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you
read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals
and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the
unborn?
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63558574:Wd6zAiWNN:m:3:2627245898:CB1C059B8A8A79B6479E50DFC2AF34C5:r

Dr. Ben
Carson

preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our
country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods
to decrease the federal government's role in society and to
improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens.

Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive. Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves? I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? Regards, Dr. Ben Carson Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute Your donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods to decrease the federal government's role in society and to improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens. name: Lauren Cooley, Institute for Faith & Culture
subject: Vote Your Faith
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Fellow American,

In the 2024 Election, it's not a matter of right
versus left - it's a matter of right versus wrong.

Morality is on the ballot...

...and the Institute for Faith & Culture is working
hard to register thousands of new Christian voters before this
year's election.

Fellow American, will you stand with the Institute for
Faith & Culture ... and believers across America ... as you
pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH in the 2024 Election?

Sign the pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH

God's hand is evident in the founding and shaping
of America. Our Founding Fathers were profoundly influenced by
biblical principles and our Judeo-Christian heritage is woven in
every founding document.

Yet, the world wants Christians to believe that our
faith has no place in the public square.

You and I know the truth: the very heart of America
is rooted in the timeless truths of Scripture!

Above: The Institute for Faith & Culture prepares
young believers for leadership every year. Let's pray for the
next generation as they confront a hostile and secular world and
bring the light of Christ to their campuses!

Fellow American, today America's godly heritage is under
attack - and the Institute for Faith & Culture, the non-profit
ministry I'm proud to lead, is pushing back against the
anti-Christian forces at play in America every day.

In this important year, the Institute for Faith &
Culture is registering thousands of voters and ensuring they
understand their civic and Biblical responsibility to vote...

...because life, religious liberty, and
righteousness in our nation are too important to remain on the
sidelines.

Fellow American, I hope you'll join us in igniting a
NATIONWIDE revival in support of biblical values! Pledge today to
VOTE YOUR FAITH in the 2024 Election.

When you sign the "Vote Your Faith" pledge, you're
not just making a personal commitment - you're joining a movement
of believers who are determined to be the salt and light our
country so desperately needs.

That's why my request today is so urgent ... and so
important.

Sign the pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH

Secularism and moral relativism are eroding our
shared values and our nation's culture. The next generation is
leaving the faith in droves, the Church's influence on culture
has waned, and a time of moral chaos and spiritual darkness has
all but taken over our country.

America is at a crossroads, and the decisions we
make in the coming years will have far-reaching consequences.

By signing this special pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH,
you are joining a growing movement of believers who refuse to be
silent, who are determined to make a difference, and who are
committed to advancing Christian principles in every area of our
society.

Please stand with the Institute of Faith & Culture
and THOUSANDS of believers across the country, as you pledge to
VOTE YOUR FAITH in the 2024 election.

Thank you for your support. Please join me in
praying ceaselessly for America's future.

Lauren Cooley

Executive Director

Institute for Faith & Culture

Sign the pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH

5555 North Federal Hwy

Fort Lauderdale, FL 33308

subject: Defend the vision of our Founding Fathers
body:

---

| | | Hello,As a fellow conservative, you likely already well know and feel the pressure that is being put upon you to abandon your principles by the progressives on the far left. You know that fighting back for what you believe in is the best thing to do.In these trying times, we conservatives must turn to the greatest document in the history of the world to promise freedom and opportunity to its citizens for guidance; **our Constitution.** That's why I'm writing today. I'd like to offer you the chance to gain **[free access to Heritage's Guide to the Constitution today to help you defend your principles against those on the far left.](http://trk.secureandprosper._KSg)**[](http://trk.secureandprosper.-cOC37opz0uYBmYJP2Kg)In this free digital interactive guide, you'll find:
* **Useful, clause-by-clause analysis** of the entire Constitution and each amendment
* Input from more than **100 constitutional scholars and legal experts** including President Reagan's former Attorney Ed Meese
* **A thorough review** of what the Constitution actually says and how it applies today
* **A copy of the Constitution** and the documents that served as its foundation

This is a critical year in our nation's history. The country is polarized and divided on a great number of issues, and roughly half of the voting population is being swayed towards greater government control over our lives--they want government-controlled health care, higher taxes and redistribution of wealth in the form of socialism, increased regulations, to do away with the Electoral College, and for open borders.It is for this reason that we need to educate as many people as possible, of all age groups, the freedoms promised to us in the Constitution.Because if we don't truly understand the freedoms that it promises to us as citizens, then we will not fight to defend those freedoms.To get your free access today and to help us make sure that everyone in the conservative movement has refreshed their understanding of the Constitution this year, will you activate your free access by clicking this link today? If so, please use this link to activate your access to the guide today: **[https://secured.heritage.org/constitution/](http://trk.secureandprosper.)** This resource has been hailed across the nation as an "outstanding Guide," which is why I consider it one of the finest resources Heritage has ever produced. I think you'll enjoy reading it, and I know you'll find use for it each day.With this powerful Guide in hand, you'll be ready to stand up to the far-Left and confidently defend the vision of our Founding Fathers.[**I hope you'll claim your copy today.**](http://trk.secureandprosper.) Thank you,Tony JohnsonDirector of Membership

| | Dear Fellow American,

I'm glad you opened my email today! I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

[**Will you take our National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT)?**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SNjW0y8ewn5ETq-GdRgRjw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoyv76P0SeaHR0cHM6Ly9pbmZvLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvY3J0LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDE1NzJOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNydHN1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1TSE9SVF9QQS1PR1QtMjAyNDA5MTZXA3NwY0IKZuEXYehmgQFkjVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)

Your participation will help us understand and address many Americans' concerns about CRT's influence on our society.

This survey will only take just a few minutes.

But in those few minutes, you'll help us gather important insights to defend America's founding principles of liberty...

...and ensure a bright future for our children and grandchildren.

**You can share your thoughts on CRT in the National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory Survey here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SNjW0y8ewn5ETq-GdRgRjw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoyv76P0SeaHR0cHM6Ly9pbmZvLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvY3J0LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDE1NzJOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNydHN1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1TSE9SVF9QQS1PR1QtMjAyNDA5MTZXA3NwY0IKZuEXYehmgQFkjVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)

Sharing your opinion is an important way you'll combat the spread of CRT in our schools and workplaces. Together, we can preserve the constitutional and free-enterprise principles that made our nation so great and so free.

Thanks in advance! I look forward to seeing your response.

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

| | Last month, I introduced the Summer Meals Act of 2024 alongside my colleagues Mary Peltola (D-AK) and Chris Smith (R-NJ). This bipartisan bill aims to fight childhood hunger by expanding students' access to healthy, nutritious meals and snacks during the summer months. **Kids should be focused on learning and getting good grades instead of worrying about where their next meal will come from.** One in six children in Washington state faces hunger. With schools out, summer months are especially hard for children in low-income and underserved communities. The Summer Meals Act builds partnerships and breaks down barriers to ensure children in the Pacific Northwest and across the country get regular, healthy meals, regardless of the season. The Summer Meals Act will:
* **Allow site sponsors to operate year-round** , enabling Summer Food Service Program (SFSP) participants to operate more efficiently;
* **Lower the area eligibility threshold from 50 percent to 40 percent** , allowing areas with at least 40 percent of students receiving free or reduced lunch to participate in the SFSP;
* **Allow summer meal sites to serve three** , rather than two, meals per day; and
* **Fund grants to encourage innovative meal delivery** , such as through mobile meal trucks, to help increase food access for children in rural and underserved areas.

When we put our values first, we can continue to introduce bipartisan bills like this one. More soon, _Rick_ | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:

Elissa is a former CIA and State Department analyst who has served Michigan's 7th Congressional District since 2019. She brings a service-oriented approach to politics, focusing on bipartisan solutions to protect America's interests and improve the lives of her constituents. I'm excited to support a new generation of leaders like Elissa who bring new perspectives and experiences to public service. She's battle-tested, running a strong campaign, and knows how to win in a purple state like Michigan. In fact, she's won in a Trump district THREE times! Earlier this year, a Fox News piece described how Republican strategists signaled outside groups to spend dark money against her. The Israeli military now admits its indiscriminate bombing killed three Israeli hostages last November. The lack of media access has prevented this information from coming to light earlier, or from holding accountable those responsible for these crimes. With so many unanswered questions, I have three that we need answered immediately if we hope to uphold peace, security, and justice. **Let 's Address This.**
**Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. Please consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..a1dyjyu9ig8qYaaXi8r6EJsjPfREV4mBDxt71ldoAZc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=148943287)
The AP reported this week [that](https://substack.com/redirect/97c90a69-c845-4639-b76c-ee8d36781670?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The Israeli military said there was a "high probability" that three hostages found dead months ago were killed in an Israeli airstrike. The army announced the conclusions of its investigation into the deaths of Cpl. Nik Beizer, Sgt. Ron Sherman and Elia Toledano.
This isn't the first time the Israeli military has killed Israeli hostages. On December 15, 2023, the Israeli military [killed hostages Alon Shamriz, Yotam Haim, and Samer Talalka](https://substack.com/redirect/e8259a5e-41b3-47a3-90dc-d626f74a3741?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), while they attempted to escape and send SOS signals. And because Netanyahu has banned all western journalists from Gaza, and additionally killed more than 100 journalists in Gaza, it is impossible to know the extent of hostages killed by the Israeli military's incessant bombing and bombardment.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/76973a94-a772-43d0-b830-63d2a06e0cdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
An Israeli couple holding an Israeli flag in Jerusalem, walk in front of graffiti calling for the release of Israeli hostages (Gil Cohen-Magen / AFP)
If we have any hope of the siege on Gaza to stop, for a safe return of all hostages, and for a lasting peace, we must have answers to these three questions immediately.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..a1dyjyu9ig8qYaaXi8r6EJsjPfREV4mBDxt71ldoAZc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148943287)
### 1\. Where is the outrage against Netanyahu over the killing of these hostages?
Among the earliest groups to sound the alarm that Netanyahu is not to be trusted were the families of hostages themselves. In a Times of Israel interview, former spokesperson for the families of hostages Haim Rubinstein lamented that the Israeli government "absolutely ignored" them and there's "[no doubt](https://substack.com/redirect/ee810691-26f1-4450-936e-f36cbcf31188?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" Netanyahu is preventing a deal. And that [after an October 26 meeting with Netanyahu he felt particularly disappointed](https://substack.com/redirect/ee810691-26f1-4450-936e-f36cbcf31188?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because the return of hostages were not the Israeli government's priority:
> We left the meeting very disappointed because Netanyahu talked about dismantling Hamas as the goal of the war. He didn't promise anything regarding the demand to return the hostages. _We later found out that Hamas had offered on October 9 or 10 to release all the civilian hostages in exchange for the IDF not entering the Strip, but the government rejected the offer_.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fbb6f548-2aea-4312-8603-f48fe5dd1d91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We cannot forget that more than 100 hostages were released through diplomacy last November, yet only a handful have been released through incessant bombing. Yet, the United States refuses to put pressure on Netanyahu in any meaningful way beyond expressing verbal concern. His bombing has killed numerous Israeli hostages and [his military has killed and kidnapped multiple American citizens](https://substack.com/redirect/228430fc-9e23-4909-8181-13f12d0a25f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Where is the meaningful outrage against Netanyahu--one that bears action to hold him accountable for these crimes? Which begs the next question.
### 2\. Why is the US Government continuing to arm Netanyahu?
Despite how divided Americans are on a number of issues, there exists remarkable unity on demanding the US Government _[stop](https://substack.com/redirect/3c4f2678-c396-49af-84f3-20ba43a40479?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[arming Netanyahu to bomb Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/3c4f2678-c396-49af-84f3-20ba43a40479?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The data is overwhelming. About 61% of Americans, 63% of moderates, and 77% of Democrats oppose weapons to Netanyahu. It is the politically smart thing for the Biden administration to do, especially if they want to maximize Harris's chances to win in November.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2b1de9b6-1176-4d25-8352-6354a0336597?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Moreover and more importantly, it is the morally and legally right thing to do. The Leahy Laws are explicitly clear that the United States cannot arm any nation that is credibly accused of war crimes--which Israel is. It should come as no surprise that more than [250 major global humanitarian organizations](https://substack.com/redirect/8926fce3-fd92-4789-8d25-9a35b97bb9bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have called on the US Government to stop arming Netanyahu. Or that seven major American labor unions including [the UAW want the US Government to stop arming Netanyahu](https://substack.com/redirect/c9321bd7-76eb-4796-afdf-38100ae29b53?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Or that major civil rights organizations like the [NAACP want the US Government to stop arming Netanyahu](https://substack.com/redirect/4086219c-f98d-4925-84ff-db90544c30d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The [United Kingdom](https://substack.com/redirect/038b7af3-b30d-47dc-b955-9f589d7aa0b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Canada](https://substack.com/redirect/040bbddb-93d5-4df7-8563-58313f0b6ed4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have both begun to restrict arms to Netanyahu. And this begs the final question--how many more innocent people must die before the US Government stops arms to Netanyahu?
### 3\. How many more innocent people need to be killed before those in power decide to uphold the Leahy Laws, the binding UN resolution for ceasefire, & enforce accountability for ICC war crimes?
It is well documented that [Hamas has repeatedly accepted the ceasefire and hostage release proposals put forth by the Israeli Government, only to have the Israeli Government back out of its own proposal and continue bombing Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/de4358bf-58e4-4433-b4d3-bcd3986824ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This week the Gaza Healthy Ministry published a comprehensive list of every Palestinian killed in Israel's siege on Gaza. Dauntingly, the first 14 pages of the 649 page single spaced document are of murdered Palestinian infants aged zero to one years old.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cd9957da-3cf5-4018-9ce8-a351a69730f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Page 1 of 649 page document from the Gaza Ministry of Health documenting each of the 42,000 known Palestinians killed in Netanyahu's bombing

| Hello Fellow Patriot,

Our nation is at a crossroads, facing immense challenges that threaten our values and the future we hope to build. Conservative principles like faith, liberty, community, and life are under constant attack. It's in times like these that we look to leaders who embody these values. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9e511485ae4147f08a30c5dceee26c39&_e=4o-sqrZ9bC9OtdUmgXQMZ4awNU78LOd5tggwWH9hXdc6ODayTiV2_1MnsDFxnTvXNB_pdEz1RhojihDOVylrCdeiigAv-_iGVqyDiXY23PFONmHEpkQA2goge7ogLBMaQIWHr8i371fmLmmYTnrnyqUuFsIUdIB1dXI9yovBkKk7hANtCsxTXXJYkBTDHvDDcACX-bBhRzNCf0xhK1s-ZxbMRqxiXeweTMFsZ-57LrQPHD5vnsRBDCT4Fss-XOEgNmuSsM3948_qrIcbVPxww-NpEgZuhtVPX8BngbZAdWQqGy01A3ktdgM_FUTpUFrseQdpXCXCZqCvJ7CcN1FgOBMZBuI8UcHdyZcR3TKBb01Q18udNZRoewvNYH44Ob4CLxSdNI_2unrYFjS6FnhJanaCx4zRIN422jNOkFiMYHc%3D) Dr. Ben Carson has dedicated his life to these principles, serving as an accomplished neurosurgeon, a Presidential cabinet member, and a steadfast champion of conservative values. But today, Dr. Carson finds himself needing your support in a deeply personal way.

**As Dr. Carson's 73rd birthday approaches, we want to fill his desk with birthday wishes from patriots like you. Will you take a moment to[sign his birthday card](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9e511485ae4147f08a30c5dceee26c39&_e=4o-sqrZ9bC9OtdUmgXQMZ4awNU78LOd5tggwWH9hXdc6ODayTiV2_1MnsDFxnTvXNB_pdEz1RhojihDOVylrCdeiigAv-_iGVqyDiXY23PFONmHEpkQA2goge7ogLBMaQIWHr8i371fmLmmYTnrnyqUuFsIUdIB1dXI9yovBkKk7hANtCsxTXXJYkBTDHvDDcACX-bBhRzNCf0xhK1s-ZxbMRqxiXeweTMFsZ-57LrQPHD5vnsRBDCT4Fss-XOEgB0HYzijZXnM3PQpWSGBI1SbTRidJo4B6TL2q3m5sNbfS4IeIPu2Ihc-M2PLOqlgxp9plZ7Lfxu1zBHWUR3d9gMz0EflAFJ3XgbxyBUAPN7Ym5maSa_BsH7vWqHlmUj6y8ARtbIiGprQLmETSknToP7AI7-e1GTtbvCvj66W1Q90%3D) and add a personal note?**

Thousands of individuals who cherish the same values have already signed the card, showing that Dr. Carson is not alone in this fight. But it will take a groundswell of support to make our collective voices heard and to show that we stand united behind leaders like Dr. Carson.

By adding your name to this card, you're not just wishing Dr. Carson a happy birthday - you're also affirming the values and principles that guide us. Together, we can make a difference and reinforce the conservative cause.

[**Click here to add your name today!**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9e511485ae4147f08a30c5dceee26c39&_e=4o-sqrZ9bC9OtdUmgXQMZ4awNU78LOd5tggwWH9hXdc6ODayTiV2_1MnsDFxnTvXNB_pdEz1RhojihDOVylrCdeiigAv-_iGVqyDiXY23PFONmHEpkQA2goge7ogLBMaQIWHr8i371fmLmmYTnrnyqUuFsIUdIB1dXI9yovBkKk7hANtCsxTXXJYkBTDHvDDcACX-bBhRzNCf0xhK1s-ZxbMRqxiXeweTMFsZ-57LrQPHD5vnsRBDCT4Fss-XOEgZnbtRca5uly8Ge4RHrRF7LQWDNTW2-zAHMAZHlx7aPiFphQhzothqQcb3rTYItyhJPShiAol_dduvckU3s6HpEiuoYcJFGdXHQs1Dwa9UOX52EyTjlCMb8U2J-P5jIkPYQ9Kse_SgBQkvzg7Z8xQ_bltjt1Ku2MwfrYb9aXov6o%3D)

After signing, you'll have the opportunity to further support the American Cornerstone Institute and the principles Dr. Carson represents. Your help is crucial in restoring faith, bringing patriotic education back to our schools, and healing the divisiveness that holds us back from real progress.

Thank you for your support, and may God bless you.

Best regards,

The American Cornerstone Institute
