After I won re-election to a full term in the Senate I turned my entire campaign operation around and started working to help build up the team we need to win in Arizona.
#

Friend —
You know I ran for U.S. Senate and won in 2020. I ran again and won in 2022. I am not up for re-election this year.
[**But today, I’m asking you to make a donation to my campaign. That might sound strange. But please, if you have a quick minute, let me explain why I need your help.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-sept24.Q50NZ9&refcode=em240916-1-120&t=1&akid=5879%2E6688874%2EimuU9L)
Arizona is one of the most competitive, hardest fought, and expensive states in the country to win an election in. Believe me, I know. Kamala Harris is on the ballot, as is Ruben Gallego, and several candidates who are running for Congress.
**What happens in Arizona over these next several weeks is going to determine what happens in our country for the next several years. I was never going to sit around and not get involved.**
After I won re-election to a full term in the Senate, I turned my entire campaign operation around and started working to help build up the team we need to keep winning in Arizona. We’ve contributed directly to campaigns, we’ve hosted fundraisers, we’ve supported these teams, and we’ve mobilized our own volunteers and staff to hit the ground and turn out voters.
That kind of work isn’t easy, or cheap. But I believe, firmly, that it is critically important. With Arizona shaping up to be as close as it ever has been this year we can’t afford to sit on the sidelines.
**I know a lot of worthy folks are asking for your help right now. But if what we’re trying to accomplish here in Arizona sounds like it’s worthy of a few dollars, please:**
[**Consider making a donation to my campaign. It’d mean a lot to me, personally.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-sept24.Q50NZ9&refcode=em240916-1-120&t=2&akid=5879%2E6688874%2EimuU9L)

| | Friend, I was sorting through old pictures with my daughter the other day and she saw a photo of me before I was injured in Afghanistan. She said to me: “Dad, I think you look better now.” Her precious words were a good reminder – my scars aren’t just cosmetic damage... They are a deep part of who I am & my story. They paint a picture of my service and commitment to my country – but more than that, they’re proof that struggle & sacrifice & pain are beautiful and not something to be avoided. When I think about my scars I feel a deep kinship with my country – America has been scarred too. Our great country has been beat-up and bloodied – but through each struggle she emerges more beautiful than before. The founders waged a bloody war to create an idea – an experiment – to prove that freedom flourishes & tyranny destroys. Against the odds and despite the challenges – America emerged more victorious and more beautiful than before. Our union was nearly torn apart by the great evil of slavery – 620,000 soldiers fell during the Civil War. Yet the star spangled banner still waved over the land of the free and the home of the brave. America ended two World Wars, demolished the Soviet Union, and stands today as a shining city on a hill to which the whole world looks for leadership and guidance. Through it all, the beautiful scars America has developed are proof that our country is the greatest, most benevolent, and freest nation in the history of mankind. It’s to that country, and the people who she represents, I have pledged my life, my service, my body, mind, and soul. As long as there is breath in my lungs and blood flowing through my veins, I will never stop fighting to make sure that America’s future is bright and beautiful. And I’d be honored beyond explanation to receive your support in my mission to continue my service to America as the next United States Senator from Nevada. **_[With the heart of a dedicated veteran and servant to our country I have a request for you:](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=fbd4cf5a3e1a48f4a7ad0a702179b81f&_e=ZaAqhsFt-d6DwfmkEbegWS5r5wLEbZPufxgC2SDijmThfBfb0ET6W5XEClgsjoMrKw9PITrxfhYwHRQNYWsThuHChfBPI5ldjyGDmXJum7IPaZiFahZD9Y7D_iNAHUMUbkaM7PGqrIYo1ywfm4C2tREe8ZvSzZb112xNbFMhrNPQ1d86g0tU_VP36F7dy-aEyOB0a9x6-afvoDOZzHg3TTdZEorcnjzlNiqTwZ8YM_qwgkQn0tFyIwVSdR9eNZCOEj3Ldid80z93NjoxEvwmVbpAr9_fUJ7spSSwvbUKmS6WoRS_U0nz0oI8DgOjXmw0cNBvqS3vA0df8jHaVY-w6UhrsFbIb3TdgQ76AC6x7jGyLQx9RNBDwFiQ44lAgr-JGTlaZQbhs-62ifxUkgxcVcgxASq--gSaZy4Wf1m5UyTov-J9Ce-cdZZsVG3dHFZnTt5WZBz_QicEMUeyODp9JPD39mnMoR-eIoraebPx4Xk%3D) _** _**[_**Would you consider supporting my mission today?**_](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=fbd4cf5a3e1a48f4a7ad0a702179b81f&_e=ZaAqhsFt-d6DwfmkEbegWS5r5wLEbZPufxgC2SDijmThfBfb0ET6W5XEClgsjoMrKw9PITrxfhYwHRQNYWsThuHChfBPI5ldjyGDmXJum7IPaZiFahZD9Y7D_iNAHUMUbkaM7PGqrIYo1ywfm4C2tREe8ZvSzZb112xNbFMhrNPQ1d86g0tU_VP36F7dy-aEyOB0a9x6-afvoDOZzHg3TTdZEorcnjzlNiqTwZ8YM_qwgkQn0tFyIwVSdR9eNZCOEj3Ldid80z93NjoxEvwmVbpAr9_fUJ7spSSwvbUKmS6WoRS_U0nz0oI8DgOjXmw0cNBvqS3vA0df8jHaVY-w6dLytGvR72j45Xcyc1pvnWg62DYw-RUqUnQS2DUJ5gaoToA4ilvdQSa1RlvlL_qXaJ24cNln2v2_AqXRV_HAkcI1XGubCZeEwNuaWBBsadLdg8IdZMTq37u6MlqGUnXTocETlQu5ZRWzPabFlDi2Mrw%3D)**_ Duty First, Captain Sam Brown

Fellow American,

Why are you hearing from me?

**Well, I was raised in New Jersey. I love this state._And I love this country._**

[**I would like you to check out what Curtis Bashaw has to say, and if you agree with him, join me in supporting him in his bid for the US Senate.**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=ed2b2769f42c4f019200c200ffddb64f&_e=fG220i_4lYYWj0Jol0F0HoyBu97j7rapoDTh_G8wX4TIR7IVO-zxzeHvkzBtpHje_jbHDkuZdHYHEvdLpa37KQVIlnm1zroKCGAgdzIkRPxXMqosiElbajR3T0rsY1SQCYmcJuac2tDfmyyBuiNaTbOw4hmJqLJQRLDxOr5z6S65_RGzWiLARYCOk47c2p_g8R09obpnYqzNKgTa9YxsUV9XbKAa6Frjs3_0E6lCZL5XCH12gHRYK9c4tO2jspz8jiMzFGTaexhSAO3Ilyt-7MRtj1dIFob8R50wKIFCCMzRlW3Bf_rqk3JoF7cIxR4HbPLu_gXezZ8vBaViTa94P6nh61HNrZqKtueuYXma_lR-zYbv6YevTtAJ-pWxw1MIT71ZwtQ0uzBaGSifEOOUKv_AgbWLuonhbgrXHndKuUc%3D)

[** JOIN CURTIS BASHAW > **](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=ed2b2769f42c4f019200c200ffddb64f&_e=fG220i_4lYYWj0Jol0F0HoyBu97j7rapoDTh_G8wX4TIR7IVO-zxzeHvkzBtpHje_jbHDkuZdHYHEvdLpa37KQVIlnm1zroKCGAgdzIkRPxXMqosiElbajR3T0rsY1SQCYmcJuac2tDfmyyBuiNaTbOw4hmJqLJQRLDxOr5z6S65_RGzWiLARYCOk47c2p_g8R09obpnYqzNKgTa9YxsUV9XbKAa6Frjs3_0E6lCZL5XCH12gHRYK9c4tO2jspz8jiMzFGTaexhSAO3Ilyt-7J3vXCF0AxtKUHRxvdFDLZpJJ64qm5LqJABAka6wViZftvGNj9RBGwBOKpTaRNjsotBMfuh7fwuWzJ2fSvzkTNGIsle5iifloH8SOGWu2_saRCKhvIl2COCWqsdfobrDeu4RfCWB-JwXSAHF1JlgEgU%3D)

I have been a known conservative in Hollywood throughout my career. It wasn’t always easy, but the latest from the bankrupt elites in my town really got to me.

After President Trump was shot, the only echo reverberating through my so-called “community” was a regret that the assassin failed to kill him. Weeks later, on a zoom call: White Dudes for Kamala. In a masterpiece of intolerance, in a breathtakingly short period of time, we learned what they are all about: _Hatred and Racism._ **Pathetic**.

I refuse to rail about the Democrats and what they have inflicted upon this country. We all know about their shortcomings, and we all know the kind of future we can bank on should they remain in power.

[**I believe Curtis Bashaw is the right kind of man to send to Washington to promote well-being in New Jersey and the United States at large. We can look to him to protect the Jersey Shore.**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=ed2b2769f42c4f019200c200ffddb64f&_e=fG220i_4lYYWj0Jol0F0HoyBu97j7rapoDTh_G8wX4TIR7IVO-zxzeHvkzBtpHje_jbHDkuZdHYHEvdLpa37KQVIlnm1zroKCGAgdzIkRPxXMqosiElbajR3T0rsY1SQCYmcJuac2tDfmyyBuiNaTbOw4hmJqLJQRLDxOr5z6S65_RGzWiLARYCOk47c2p_g8R09obpnYqzNKgTa9YxsUV9XbKAa6Frjs3_0E6lCZL5XCH12gHRYK9c4tO2jspz8jiMzFGTaexhSAO3Ilyt-7HDnUCg72cmZmm8oe0kP8o1qpDXvJFTdPjOBFgsUbOZT7xUMjYXGGFHxcscAsFnGqogWPsVw2svuBs06BQ7TnDvInemgy8I5hErWrH1ZQPtF8FxXXT2x_GefjnOZpYBTQ82JQ2ZOYc2NuvfdMGMtggo%3D)

We can look to him to promote prosperity for all—a good paycheck and food we can afford. But more importantly, he is a good man. A man of good character. A man whose voice can be trusted as he raises his hand to preserve the Constitution of the United States. Our Constitution.

subject: 10 years for $1
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alma Adams for Congress

| Peter, I’ve always said, _working hard is not enough when you’re not earning enough_.

While workers in other states have seen their wages rise over time, North Carolinians are still stuck at the federal minimum wage, despite the rising cost of living.

_**I fought and sponsored the 2006 minimum wage increase, and I still continue to fight for fair wages in Congress.**_

Hey Peter, born-and-raised Missourian John Goodman here.
**The stakes are high this election year — especially in Missouri’s U.S. Senate race.** Here we’ve got Josh Hawley, the coward of January 6th, up against Lucas Kunce, a 13-year Marine veteran who knows what it’s like to grow up through hardship, fight for his community, and serve our country.
I’m proud to support Lucas, and in a moment I’ll ask you to join me in splitting a donation between him and Bob Casey. But first, I want to tell you why I know that Lucas can defeat Hawley this year and why his grassroots campaign urgently needs our help. **Please let me explain.**
**[Chip In Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240916-3?refcode=em20240916-3&refcode2=4204_552475_QHCChO&akid=4204%2E552475%2EQHCChO)**
I’ll be honest: I’ve been ready to defeat Josh Hawley since January 6th, 2021.
He totally disgraced my home state that day... raising his fist because he wanted to look strong, and then running away like a little coward out the back door.
**But Josh Hawley has done a lot more than just that to embarrass Missouri over the years, stuff you probably wouldn’t even believe.**
Hawley himself played a major role in overturning Roe v. Wade — he even bragged about it! He backs the total abortion ban in Missouri, co-sponsored a national abortion ban, and is a pioneer of the legal movement threatening access to IVF and birth control nationwide.
Hawley forced Missouri taxpayers to cover his legal bills after he broke the law — $250,000, in this economy! He’s refused to invest a single dollar in Missouri, instead spending all his time writing stuff like his “Manhood” self-help book.
It’s just shameful.
**[Chip In Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240916-3?refcode=em20240916-3&refcode2=4204_552475_QHCChO&akid=4204%2E552475%2EQHCChO)**
**Now let’s talk about Lucas Kunce.** I learned about Lucas probably the same way many of you did, from online ads and emails just like this one.
I heard Lucas’ story of struggle and community, which reminded me of my own. I’m sure it resonates with you too. I also saw he was running a real campaign — outraising Hawley, earning record-breaking support, bringing people together regardless of what party they’re from or who they’ve voted for before.
And I saw it’s made the polls get closer, too.
I’m all-in to help Lucas because I know he can win this race. I know Missouri can elect a Senator we can all be proud of. And I know if we all pitch in, we can run that coward Josh Hawley out of the Senate!
**I’m about to get to the most important part of this email, but first I need to ask:**[**Will you please join me in supporting Lucas Kunce in his race against Josh Hawley and Bob Casey by splitting $10 or more to their campaigns today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240916-3?refcode=em20240916-3&refcode2=4204_552475_QHCChO&akid=4204%2E552475%2EQHCChO)
**[Donate $25 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240916-3?refcode=em20240916-3&refcode2=4204_552475_QHCChO&akid=4204%2E552475%2EQHCChO)**
**[Donate $50 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240916-3?refcode=em20240916-3&refcode2=4204_552475_QHCChO&akid=4204%2E552475%2EQHCChO)**
**[Other Amount ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240916-3?refcode=em20240916-3&refcode2=4204_552475_QHCChO&akid=4204%2E552475%2EQHCChO)**
I want you to take what I’m about to tell you seriously, Peter.
**With so much on the line this year, Missouri’s U.S. Senate race is one of the most important in America — one of our ONLY chances to flip a GOP-held seat.**
**First off, Josh Hawley is far more vulnerable than any national news outlet will lead you to believe.** Hawley won his last election with only 51% of the vote, with a margin weaker than Trump’s by double digits. Since then, polls consistently show he’s the least popular GOP Senator up for re-election this cycle, with approval ratings even lower than Ted Cruz in Texas and Rick Scott in Florida.
Maybe even more telling than all that... after January 6th, Hawley’s former mentor, three-term Missouri Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth said supporting Hawley’s campaign in 2018 was _“the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.”_
Hawley’s base abandoned him. And he hasn’t won them back.
**[Chip In Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240916-3?refcode=em20240916-3&refcode2=4204_552475_QHCChO&akid=4204%2E552475%2EQHCChO)**
**Meanwhile, Lucas has consistently played offense** — holding Hawley accountable for his extreme record while getting his own positive message of taking back power for working people in front of voters across Missouri.
He’s earned critical support from Missouri’s election-winning labor movement, groups like Abortion Action Missouri, Social Security Works, and End Citizens United — and even the Missouri Fire Fighters, who normally endorse Republicans. **With help from real people like you, all across the country, he’s built a record-breaking movement to flip this Senate seat.**
Frankly, Peter, Lucas Kunce and Missouri’s U.S. Senate race haven’t got the attention they deserve this year. But that’s OK, because it hasn’t changed this truth:
**Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley if he has the resources to make it happen.**
**[Chip In Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240916-3?refcode=em20240916-3&refcode2=4204_552475_QHCChO&akid=4204%2E552475%2EQHCChO)**
Time isn't on our side here. November 5th will be here before we know it, and we’ve gotta make every moment count for Lucas and the team.
We’ve gotta make sure they have the resources to fight back hard against the onslaught of attacks that have already started from Hawley and his campaign.
Oh yeah, I forgot to mention — _Hawley is so afraid of Lucas, he hasn’t even run a single ad about his own record in the Senate._ It’s all just false attack ads against Lucas!
**If you’re able to support Lucas right now in this important moment, you can make a real difference for our country this year, Peter.** So I’m personally asking:
**[Will you please join me in supporting Lucas and Bob Casey’s campaigns by donating $10, $25, or just whatever you can today? Lucas is committed to running his campaign the right way, without a single cent from corporate PACs, so anything you’re able to give really will make a big impact.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240916-3?refcode=em20240916-3&refcode2=4204_552475_QHCChO&akid=4204%2E552475%2EQHCChO)**
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240916-3?refcode=em20240916-3&refcode2=4204_552475_QHCChO&akid=4204%2E552475%2EQHCChO)**
Thank you for listening,
John Goodman
Born-and-raised Missourian

This is a historic moment — but the work’s not over.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39105%2E3422442%2Ea7tHzL)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240916-sarah?refcode=em20240916-39105&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39105_3422442_a7tHzL&akid=39105%2E3422442%2Ea7tHzL)
Derek, I’m Sarah McBride.
In 2020, I defied the odds and became the first openly trans person elected to serve as a State Senator anywhere in the country.
**Now, I am the official Democratic nominee to represent Delaware in Congress.**

WE'RE ON THE BRINK
Nuclear War is Closer Than Ever—
Help Me Stop It!
Dear Peter,
There’s no greater issue facing our country – and the world – than the reckless march toward nuclear war.
Today, Secretary Blinken and the Biden administration are discussing a dangerous move to provide Ukraine with long-range Western-made missiles capable of striking deep into Russian territory. [**I’m calling on them to stop immediately:**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=on_the_brink_9_16_24_all_1&n=5)
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=on_the_brink_9_16_24_all_1&n=6)
This is about survival, not politics. The neoconservatives who pushed us into disastrous wars in Iraq, Libya, and Syria have taken over the Democratic Party, and they are driving us to the brink of nuclear conflict with Russia.
**Do you understand how dangerous this is?** Right now, our country is giving weapons, training, and targeting information to Ukraine to strike inside Russia. How would we react if Russia had military bases on our Mexican border and was helping Mexico target oil refineries, towns, and nuclear plants in Texas?
[If Russia becomes desperate, they **will** use nuclear weapons. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=on_the_brink_9_16_24_all_1&n=7)
The Biden administration and the foreign policy establishment are gambling with the future of the entire human race. And for what? Endless wars that have already bankrupted our nation. Now, they’re risking everything in an unnecessary and catastrophic confrontation with a nuclear power.
**We must step back from the brink – now.******
This is why I decided to leave the Presidential race and endorse Donald Trump. After many conversations with him, I believe he understands the gravity of this situation. Trump will deescalate tensions with Russia and put an end to the neocon agenda for war with Iran and China. I take him at his word, and I will also keep him to his word.
My immediate focus in Washington will be to ensure that President Trump can stop this reckless march toward nuclear war and return us to a government that puts **peace and the people** first.
[But I can’t do this without your immediate support. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=on_the_brink_9_16_24_all_1&n=8)
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=on_the_brink_9_16_24_all_1&n=9)
We are at a critical crossroads. I am committed to taking bold action to challenge the corruption entrenched in Washington and stop the neocon agenda that threatens all of us.
[Donate now](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=on_the_brink_9_16_24_all_1&n=10) to give me the resources I need to end this escalation and restore a government that works for the people – before it’s too late.
Thank you for standing strong with me for the future of America.

Hi, it's Tobias Read, Oregon State Treasurer and candidate for Oregon Secretary of State.
I’m proud to have worked as a public servant for most of my adult life.
As Treasurer, I take my duty to the people of Oregon seriously. That means showing up to work each and every day ready to deliver for every Oregonian, no matter who they voted for.
But my opponent clearly has a different conception of public service.
As a state senator, he broke the law by refusing to show up to work. In fact, thanks to his boycott, he missed so many days that he is legally barred from running for re-election!
At a moment when the challenges our state faces demand dedication and hard work from our public servants, the last thing we should do is promote my opponent to Secretary of State.
That’s why I’m asking for your help to ensure our victory this November. I’m committed to showing up and working hard for Oregonians all across our state, but I need your help to get to the finish line. Please, can I count on you to step up? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240916em-job]
DONATE NOW >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240916em-job]
The MAGA movement has worked across the country to harass election workers, undermine faith in our institutions, and deny the results of free and fair elections.
And my opponent proudly aligns himself with that movement and its leader, Donald Trump.
That’s why I know that my opponent is the wrong person to oversee our state’s elections system.
But I can’t win this race and defend our democracy alone, so please, can I count on you to chip in any amount to help us be successful? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240916em-extremism]
Thank you,
Tobias

to hold this right-wing government accountable for taking her life as well
as the lives of more than 40,000 Palestinian civilians.

Our Justice Democrats-endorsed members of Congress have led the call for
peace and justice since October 7th, with Representatives Cori Bush and
Rashida Tlaib introducing the first bill demanding an immediate, permanent
ceasefire in Gaza and the release of hostages on both sides. Fellow JD
members joined them in becoming some of the first to stand on the right
side of history on this issue.

Now, Rep. Delia Ramirez and Rep. Pramila Jayapal are demanding
accountability for Ayşenur’s murder and the escalating violence in the
West Bank.

Delia issued a letter signed by 20 of her House colleagues, including 7
other Justice Democrats, to U.S. Secretary of State Anthony Blinken asking
the Biden Administration for specific, significant actions to hold Israel
accountable and prevent further settlement expansion and violence against
Palestinians.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240916.TCGeqt&refcode=em20240916-35995&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=35995%2E1203867%2E_XD16b ]Tweet from @repdeliaramirez: @SecBlinken, I agree. The killing of
Aysenur Ezgi Eygi was unprovoked and unjustified. Israeli security forces
must fundamentally change the way they operate in the West Bank. That’s
why I am leading 20 of my colleagues to ask for the specific actions our
government will take to hold Israel security forces accountable for the
death of an American citizen and ensure the end to settlement expansion
and violence against Palestinians.

Pramila sent a similar letter demanding the U.S. oversee an independent
investigation into the Israeli military’s killing of Ayşenur, and clear
next steps to prevent further loss of innocent lives.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240916.TCGeqt&refcode=em20240916-35995&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=35995%2E1203867%2E_XD16b ]Tweet from @RepJayapal: NEW: Sen. Patty Murray and I are calling on the
admin to conduct an independent, U.S.-led investigation into the killing
of Aysenur Ezgi Eygi by the IDF. We must pursue accountability for those
involved to ensure this never happens again.

While we wait for President Biden and his cabinet to finally do something
about the Israeli military’s genocide against Palestinians and killing of
American citizens, it is beyond clear that we need more Justice Democrats
like Delia and Pramila in Congress fighting for the rights of ALL people.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240916.TCGeqt&refcode=em20240916-35995&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=35995%2E1203867%2E_XD16b ]Help us recruit and elect more progressive leaders to office who are

Peter,

Why are you hearing from me?

**Well, I was raised in New Jersey. I love this state._And I love this country._**

[**I would like you to check out what Curtis Bashaw has to say, and if you agree with him, join me in supporting him in his bid for the US Senate.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=be4dcf1e08ed4691a8dd1ee67cd41454&_e=zvdh2F9FLjDBGSc3Ixufxow4xVXgbjYGRjf6O2dM6NUb7TIssUPKmV-8aelvwGqr1nYbOQQUDzhjvBp4AEc-GnfMdgfvdeYTOaTq5cGW43z0oqlPJIQ28cyKiCJfg6bQrp_nLwU4qUjQhd_xYdVSOxdoFXJmh-mxblkd3vzsyG_bVAohM_B0BBVTL4WT8t4Q-EdEcTt3MaN9AnE4q41RK8HIgmUCEXYhezGr8NRMPcSH68BmcDkAZSR8nsnr0TAp3I87eV-kvA1z1aWmupSVY1ITYSBd4TrHFDXh4Yhfa8-JRgv9WHs6U0m-iLQRyeYAYyb-zTv_UmaVsN76_GcwFU-bEgOH79HWECS_G4MXEEoW0vkqmWRZeUfAVR5_WG6sAMJNPCmN5CTs8YdsA-3I_XCqsdDne1VxW2qHn2nkPdc%3D)

[** JOIN CURTIS BASHAW > **](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=be4dcf1e08ed4691a8dd1ee67cd41454&_e=zvdh2F9FLjDBGSc3Ixufxow4xVXgbjYGRjf6O2dM6NUb7TIssUPKmV-8aelvwGqr1nYbOQQUDzhjvBp4AEc-GnfMdgfvdeYTOaTq5cGW43z0oqlPJIQ28cyKiCJfg6bQrp_nLwU4qUjQhd_xYdVSOxdoFXJmh-mxblkd3vzsyG_bVAohM_B0BBVTL4WT8t4Q-EdEcTt3MaN9AnE4q41RK8HIgmUCEXYhezGr8NRMPcSH68BmcDkAZSR8nsnr0TAp3I87eV-kvA1z1aWmupSVY-cwjt_kbdY4GjYPXzFSyWFVU4DgITYlcDc2LtA5F4FW2Sn63K9AybLUM3F3MneBLcv3Yc0nhFQoxf-t2tyUzwikTa9c_8VEQBHxjoChMHJ0ksftH69By4Go2mBVOi-Ymh9o81kou6UwRKb6qn44gVM%3D)

I have been a known conservative in Hollywood throughout my career. It wasn’t always easy, but the latest from the bankrupt elites in my town really got to me.

After President Trump was shot, the only echo reverberating through my so-called “community” was a regret that the assassin failed to kill him. Weeks later, on a zoom call: White Dudes for Kamala. In a masterpiece of intolerance, in a breathtakingly short period of time, we learned what they are all about: _Hatred and Racism._ **Pathetic**.

I refuse to rail about the Democrats and what they have inflicted upon this country. We all know about their shortcomings, and we all know the kind of future we can bank on should they remain in power.

[**I believe Curtis Bashaw is the right kind of man to send to Washington to promote well-being in New Jersey and the United States at large. We can look to him to protect the Jersey Shore.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=be4dcf1e08ed4691a8dd1ee67cd41454&_e=zvdh2F9FLjDBGSc3Ixufxow4xVXgbjYGRjf6O2dM6NUb7TIssUPKmV-8aelvwGqr1nYbOQQUDzhjvBp4AEc-GnfMdgfvdeYTOaTq5cGW43z0oqlPJIQ28cyKiCJfg6bQrp_nLwU4qUjQhd_xYdVSOxdoFXJmh-mxblkd3vzsyG_bVAohM_B0BBVTL4WT8t4Q-EdEcTt3MaN9AnE4q41RK8HIgmUCEXYhezGr8NRMPcSH68BmcDkAZSR8nsnr0TAp3I87eV-kvA1z1aWmupSVY-TnCF46Q8wbutxfPJuX3Cv5MrupxeLe-sP3PbqpZjfOFCzGQfnOKZ9xu03HNzrzil4phcZQzF0LFTGzfF7aFpJ7gtVDPJYQ8T5gVonUjKGmGrM6hSk_DFYXkpM25ModhnOMbtcY5bW1uWs21p0gyo0%3D)

We can look to him to promote prosperity for all—a good paycheck and food we can afford. But more importantly, he is a good man. A man of good character. A man whose voice can be trusted as he raises his hand to preserve the Constitution of the United States. Our Constitution.

[**There comes a time when we have to speak out in support of our nation’s traditional values. For Patriotism. For the right to pursue happiness on our own terms.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=be4dcf1e08ed4691a8dd1ee67cd41454&_e=zvdh2F9FLjDBGSc3Ixufxow4xVXgbjYGRjf6O2dM6NUb7TIssUPKmV-8aelvwGqr1nYbOQQUDzhjvBp4AEc-GnfMdgfvdeYTOaTq5cGW43z0oqlPJIQ28cyKiCJfg6bQrp_nLwU4qUjQhd_xYdVSOxdoFXJmh-mxblkd3vzsyG_bVAohM_B0BBVTL4WT8t4Q-EdEcTt3MaN9AnE4q41RK8HIgmUCEXYhezGr8NRMPcSH68BmcDkAZSR8nsnr0TAp3I87eV-kvA1z1aWmupSVY9Js1aM7mdZS-L60upBPdyEkueEzee4uWoLNGgkbn5dwN7w5xt60ED-zTwEEGC8R3KNp99ChbZ8lw2tSdQzLwBBVfe4J-vjK4WZW4XkhN2keVPUwK5peQzXUz3XrlNsRoIh9YLJCifd_gBL7SQbDCkg%3D)

[** DONATE TO CURTIS BASHAW > **](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=be4dcf1e08ed4691a8dd1ee67cd41454&_e=zvdh2F9FLjDBGSc3Ixufxow4xVXgbjYGRjf6O2dM6NUb7TIssUPKmV-8aelvwGqr1nYbOQQUDzhjvBp4AEc-GnfMdgfvdeYTOaTq5cGW43z0oqlPJIQ28cyKiCJfg6bQrp_nLwU4qUjQhd_xYdVSOxdoFXJmh-mxblkd3vzsyG_bVAohM_B0BBVTL4WT8t4Q-EdEcTt3MaN9AnE4q41RK8HIgmUCEXYhezGr8NRMPcSH68BmcDkAZSR8nsnr0TAp3I87eV-kvA1z1aWmupSVYxifsjvj6YJeO4mpMKCsXJVpyKaTu4qF37-haFpWANE8eEVVzxaZKzzqB8dKu04J2zEBu2_ug1_pv5YMlZvcknqZV1tVthCIffCJmJcZlG5nPH1j810Jnvw0ZU3jq_zigh1GZgRMY_2HJ9Yyqx8DTi0%3D)

We need a remedy for what Washington has been doing.

Curtis Bashaw in the United States Senate could be that remedy or at least a good part of it.

Please join me in supporting Curtis Bashaw.

Cheerfully and flag-wavingly yours!

Kelsey Grammer

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

* **TOP NEWS**

**" LaPorte pipeline fire prompts Houston area closures,"** Houston Chronicle's**Rebekah F. Ward** and**Octavia Johnson** -- "An investigation is ongoing after a pipeline caught on [fire Monday in La Porte, near Spencer Highway](https://substack.com/redirect/541a770b-9112-4c16-a347-c3a9e4ee2f66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Emergency responders started working Monday morning to extinguish the flames that officials said could keep burning for hours.

Deer Park Office of Emergency Management officials said in an afternoon release that a valve station for a 20-inch natural gas liquids line resulted in a fire. The officials said they are unsure about how long it will take for the flames to be extinguished.

The pipeline, located near the border between Deer Park, La Porte and Pasadena, [is owned by Energy Transfer](https://substack.com/redirect/3f5f18db-009c-499b-b7cc-1ddbeb69b7ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), according to a statement from the company and emergency officials.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/188a7df5-48cd-475f-9bcc-1eb0ab0cb0b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The La Porte Fire Department responded to the fire at 9:55 a.m. in the 8700 block of Spencer Highway, city of La Porte spokesperson**Lee Woodward** said in a release. Deer Park OEM also went to the scene, setting up a mobile command post at East Boulevard and Spencer Highway. Harris County Pollution Control Services responded to the scene following emissions complaints Monday morning.

The Harris County Fire Marshal's Office and the American Red Cross are assisting at the scene.

"The La Porte Fire Department is on the scene and has evacuated all homes and businesses within a half mile of the incident site. The line has been isolated so that the residual product in the line can safely burn itself out. We have no timeline at this point on how long that process will take, but we are working closely with local authorities," Energy Transfer representatives said in the statement.

In an update just before 3 p.m., La Porte officials announced they had reduced the size of the evacuation area created because of the pipeline fire." body:
I’m hoping you’ll stand with me now when it matters the most.
#
Listen, I know who I am.
And I know what I represent — to my constituents, I represent a fighter who will never stop working to make our communities stronger. To the LGBTQ+ community, I’m an advocate who holds a powerful position of visibility. **But to the far-right extremists in this country?_I am a threat._**
For Democrats, our power is in our diversity and always has been. As that power grows, so do the attacks on what makes us diverse, and behind those attacks are millions and millions of dollars from folks who are doing everything they can to keep the status quo.
**We don’t need their millions, but we do need you: Your donations, your investments, your support.**
**I am officially the Democratic nominee for Delaware’s only seat in the U.S. House, and if I win this race, I’ll be the first openly transgender member in Congress.** That’s why we’re fully expecting right-wing extremists, like Marjorie Taylor Greene, to ramp up their disgusting attacks on me.
[**I’m asking you, personally, to donate $5 right now to become a Founding Donor to my general election campaign, help me fight back, and win.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240916-1?refcode=em20240916-1-1219&amount=5&refcode2=1219_21716_DFI984&akid=1219%2E21716%2EDFI984)
It’s an investment in the critical work ahead and to show that we won’t let far-right extremism scare us — vote by vote, ballot by ballot. This is about building a better country. _Together._
Simply put: We are not going back. Our opponents are trying to tell us that we do not belong, but we can show them our democracy is big enough for ALL of us.
Thanks to the support I’ve received in Delaware and across the country, we have a real shot of winning this race and finally shattering this national lavender glass ceiling. But I also need you to stand with me.
[**Can you pitch in $5 now?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240916-1?refcode=em20240916-1-1219&amount=5&refcode2=1219_21716_DFI984&akid=1219%2E21716%2EDFI984)

Thank you for investing in hope and history. Let’s get this done.
Sarah

For Democrats, our power is in our diversity and always has been. As that power grows, so do the attacks on what makes us diverse, and behind those attacks are millions and millions of dollars from folks who are doing everything they can to keep the status quo. We don’t need their millions, but we do need you: Your donations, your investments, your support. I am officially the Democratic nominee for Delaware’s only seat in the U.S. House, and if I win this race, I’ll be the first openly transgender member in Congress. That’s why we’re fully expecting right-wing extremists, like Marjorie Taylor Greene, to ramp up their disgusting attacks on me. It’s an investment in the critical work ahead and to show that we won’t let far-right extremism scare us — vote by vote, ballot by ballot. This is about building a better country. Together. Simply put: We are not going back. Our opponents are trying to tell us that we do not belong, but we can show them our democracy is big enough for ALL of us. Thanks to the support I’ve received in Delaware and across the country, we have a real shot of winning this race and finally shattering this national lavender glass ceiling. But I also need you to stand with me. Thank you for investing in hope and history. Let’s get this done. Sarah

| Peter,

I won’t lie: asking for your hard-earned dollars is not my favorite part of this campaign, and bugging you on Monday night isn’t a joy of mine either. But here’s why your investment is so important, and why my team asked me to send you this note before midnight.

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Jordan's dangerous rhetoric has consequences
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
It’s become painfully clear that we’re living through dangerous times — where hateful words, divisive rhetoric, and inflammatory lies aren’t just stoking tension; they’re fueling real violence in our streets and communities.
What was once dismissed as heated political talk is now putting lives at risk as those who spew hatred give rise to acts of aggression and chaos.
This isn't about politics — it’s about our country’s future, our safety, and the need for healing.
Just this week, we witnessed another attempt at the life of former President Trump.
Thankfully, no one was injured, but this is another wake-up call – especially after a week straight of MAGA politicians directing violence at the people of Springfield with dangerous lies.
It’s time for Trump, Jim Jordan, and the rest of the MAGA world to turn down the temperature on their rhetoric and stop the hateful messaging.
We can’t keep living in a world where political violence is fueled by lies, hate speech, and personal vendettas.
We need leaders who want to heal our nation, not tear it apart.
Politicians like Jim Jordan have used rhetoric that has fanned the flames of chaos, doubling down on conspiracies that threaten our democracy and inspire violence.
If you're with me in fighting for a safer, more united country, then I need your support for our campaign today. Every contribution helps us push back against the chaos and bring real leadership to Washington. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240916_trump_incident_link1]
While we can be thankful no harm came from this latest incident, we will not ignore the environment created by Jim Jordan, JD Vance, and Donald Trump's dangerous words and lies.
From false claims about widespread voter fraud to pushing conspiracies that Democrats are running secret child trafficking rings, (I won’t mention Matt Gaetz and his recent charge of child trafficking) the ULTRA-MAGA world have poisoned the well of our democracy.
This kind of dehumanization fuels violence and hate crimes across the country. Jim Jordan hasn’t been a leader, someone who squashes such talk. Oh no, he adds fuel to the fire by always adding something offensive. He defends the lies and conspiracies, enabling the very chaos that puts our communities at risk.
That's what makes our election the most important Congressional race in the country.
Jim Jordan has led us down a dangerous road, and we need principled representatives in office to bring some order and safety back to our politics.
Let’s remind them that leadership isn’t about tearing each other down, but about building each other up.
With your help, we can be the voice of reason and the force for change. If you're able, a contribution today will help us spread this message of hope, unity, and peace. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240916_trump_incident_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

A single mom and survivor who knows what it’s like to endure and overcome challenges, Tamie's fighting for jobs, healthcare, and positive change for everyday Americans. Peter,
Donald Trump and JD Vance may have taken their **anti-immigrant hate** to new levels lately — promoting baseless conspiracy theories, calling for mass deportations, and more — but this playbook is nothing new.
MAGA Republicans have stoked anti-immigrant hate as a tool to divide and degrade our politics for years. Trump first launched his 2016 campaign with racist smears and never stopped spreading hatred.
**But while MAGA may be content to do nothing but fearmonger, Pramila is working hard to make real progress happen.[Will you sign on now to show your support for Pramila’s efforts to pass humane immigration reform in Congress?](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/immigration-reform-em20240916?source=em20240916&akid=4297%2E420207%2EBYclA6)**
Here’s what humane immigration reform looks like:
* Ensuring all asylum seekers have their claims processed quickly and fairly

* Providing a pathway to citizenship for the millions of undocumented immigrants who already live here

* Protecting immigrant employees from abuse in the workplace

* Removing cruel and unnecessary barriers to accessing healthcare

...and more. And while Pramila’s been working to get these reforms passed into law, she’s also been hard at work supporting immigrant communities in other ways too.
In July, she called for the closure of private, for-profit immigration detention centers. And just a few weeks ago, she announced $4 million in DHS funding to support migrants here in King County.
**But getting bigger reforms passed means electing more progressives to Congress and making sure our leaders know it needs to be a priority.[So Peter, if you’re with Pramila in this fight, will you sign on to our petition calling on Congress to pass humane immigration reform today?](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/immigration-reform-em20240916?source=em20240916&akid=4297%2E420207%2EBYclA6)**
